acceptedRequirements: Start with a selected comment or direct spin request
Race, archetype, and backstory each have result-specific event wheels
Main stats are strength, speed, durability, intelligence, and fight
Weapon is followed by weapon mastery; master or higher unlocks enchantment
Power follows the weapon pattern without enchantment
Then weakness, apex force, conditional stat boost, and title with possible hidden events
Generate the character image from resolved results, then display final stats
Every spin before main stats affects the probability distribution of later relevant wheels
Every spin, including event wheels, receives narrator commentary, meme video, and text
Mechanics first; detailed names and cultural content later
Use familiar mixed Indonesian/English labels rather than strict Indonesian translations
Allow Siluman to roll multiple animal types
Expand mythical beasts using researched references

raceGroupingContract.probabilityRule: Use the product of conditional draw probabilities for a complete path. For multiple routes to the same resolved identity, aggregate route probabilities explicitly. Multi-animal draws update the eligible pool without replacement and freeze odds before each draw.
raceGroupingContract.effectRule: Pre-stat selections declare later eligibility/odds effects. Animal/legacy influence profiles remain proposals until guards, numerical balance, and complete event outcomes are defined.
raceGroupingContract.reactionRule: Every actual family, origin, type, animal/component parent, form, any separately authorized fusion, legacy, and event spin has its own committed result and reaction beat.
raceGroupingContract.ancestryRule: Finish the selected identity's selectors/events, then run main archetype. Additional ancestry does not automatically reopen active family events. Shared subtree re-entry requires an explicit bounded call and consumed-event keys.

silumanComposition.status: User-confirmed twelve animal choices, exactly one animal spin per character, and humanoid normal form with animal traits; full-animal transformation uses the selected type.
silumanComposition.journalPolicy: One stable source animal component and one committed animal result/reaction.
silumanComposition.duplicatePolicy: Exactly one animal result for this source; no repeated animal draw.
silumanComposition.poolExhaustion: Twelve eligible choices at equal base weights; an empty filtered pool is a configuration error.
silumanComposition.orderPolicy: One selected animal; no dominance or fusion wheel.
silumanComposition.effectsPolicy: Animal Transformation only; Babi also Nyolong. No automatic numeric traits or other power grants.
silumanComposition.compatibilityPolicy: Approved normal form is humanoid with animal traits; role fit follows explicit body/capability profiles.
silumanComposition.mythicalBoundary: Siluman animal adaptation does not dispatch Mythical Beast events.

baseForm.sizeReferencePolicy: Humanoid normal-body reference at global Size; source-backed numerical reference remains to be assigned.

legendaryIdentity.identityPolicy: Record selected family, resolved base species/ancestry, origin, legacy reference, source kind, and power/training path separately.
legendaryIdentity.inheritanceMode: Inspired successor/legacy character; copying a named reference character's full canonical power package is not assumed.
legendaryIdentity.archetypePolicy: Legendary identity skips Archetype under accepted policy 1.0.0; preserve its signature package and later stages.
legendaryIdentity.grantPolicy: One explicit four-point source-bound boost package per committed hero: power, weapon, numeric stats or scoped mastery. Ten Japanese/eight other-story replacements in eighty Imported. Current package replaces prior revision for new spins; historical committed journals remain intact. Thirty Local unchanged; no full canon inventory or extra events.
legendaryIdentity.artifactPolicy: Separate identity/reference vessel metadata from owned equipment. Historical/Fate vessel and legacy artifacts do not grant additional forms, races, enchantments or items.
legendaryIdentity.baseResolutionPolicy: Keep explicit reference identity separate from generated body/ancestry and attached race components. Sourced Size and combined anatomy remain pending; never silently use Human/vehicle/toy averages.
legendaryIdentity.referenceVersionPolicy: Each profile names its tradition or character version. Reference identity is context; no additional race dispatch, history consumption, combined forms or unlisted equipment/powers.
legendaryIdentity.crossoverPolicy: A future archetype/backstory legacy event may reuse this subtree on an existing race without overwriting its ancestry. Additional crossover entry points remain proposed.
legendaryIdentity.animeBoundary: Anime Genre/Role events belong only to the standalone Anime family; Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris has no Anime category. Prior named MC templates are archived inactive.
legendaryIdentity.selectionPolicy: Origin fixed Local 65% / Imported 35% followed directly by one named-character spin; no intermediate category, training, theme, color, series or franchise selector.

reincarnationTheme.theme: Reincarnation of a selected legendary reference as the generated character theme.
reincarnationTheme.mechanicalBoundary: Apply only selected existing source-profile package. No new reincarnation/past-life wheel, automatic memory/skill/full-canon inventory, fixed Backstory or skipped main stage.

raceGroupingContract.selectorOrder: followupWheelId resolves first; resolvePlan executes afterward in declared order unless explicitly stated. Referenced selectors are sequential siblings at the race stage, not recursive restarts of the main race wheel.
raceGroupingContract.fixedIdentityRule: A fixed known identity is recorded and revealed without manufacturing a random spin. Every actual spin retains its own result/reaction. Exception: Dwarf armor awards explicitly require N actual piece spins, including a final 100%-probability spin when only one unique piece remains.
raceGroupingContract.classification: Game selection families may group species, hybrid lineages, spiritual roles, or legacy paths. Store resolved base identity separately. Lokal/Impor describes a reference style, including Indonesian adaptations of shared traditions; it does not assert exclusive origin.
raceGroupingContract.executableStatus: Design only; unspecified base weights use the user-confirmed equal default. Full event profiles, catalogs, scales and conditional influence remain pending.

hybridComposition.status: User-confirmed two sequential race components with normal events and shared nested history.
hybridComposition.eligibleFamilyPolicy: Use the complete canonical main race pool, including Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris, Anime and Heavenly Principle. Filter all previously selected families; Hybrid is already used when its event starts, so it cannot select itself.
hybridComposition.componentResolution: Spin component 1, commit its family/history before dispatch, and finish every immediate event and nested race chain. Register later-stage tickets without advancing main stages. Only then spin component 2 using the accumulated history and run its events the same way.
hybridComposition.distinctnessPolicy: Before every identity-family draw disable ALL previously committed families across both roots and every nested host/origin, not just the first root or final leaf. Filter before draw, never reroll forbidden results.
hybridComposition.poolExhaustion: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
hybridComposition.eventOrder: Hybrid result/reaction → component 1 result/reaction and complete immediate nested chain → component 2 result/reaction and complete immediate chain → record completion → saved caller. No fusion stability or dominance wheel.
hybridComposition.eventScope: Only an actual explicit Hybrid family selection opens this two-root sequence; lore Half-Ghoul/Half-Demon/Demigod or reference ancestry does not dispatch it automatically.
hybridComposition.journalPolicy: Two stable root slots 1/2, with separately linked host/origin descendants. Every invocation carries component/parent/root-slot and return continuation. History is shared globally.
hybridComposition.effectsPolicy: Retain every explicitly approved grant, modifier, guarantee and deferred ticket from both actual chains. Apply each source once under source-once additive stacking with no numeric floor/cap. No blanket stat addition, halving, automatic power package, suppression or extra mastery spin.
hybridComposition.anatomyPolicy: Store both root identities and nested modifiers in one body brief. Anatomical conflict/body-reference policy remains pending; do not invent stability/dominance results or discard committed race rewards.
hybridComposition.returnTo: saved caller; archetype for ordinary main race-stage chain
hybridComposition.size: One global Size: current normal-form profiles cover all completed owner identity routes. Use adjustable same-metric mixture or explicit principal-extent projection for mixed metrics; an explicit all-source frozen body range wins. Raksasa retains eight milestones. AI artwork prose is not a probability parameter or physical mass.
hybridComposition.mastery: All owned powers share the existing single character mastery and scoped Authority exception. Weapons keep their normal per-weapon mastery/Enchant.
hybridComposition.context: Append actual roots, nested families, grants, modifiers and upcoming steps with provenance. Future second race and final stats remain unknown until committed.
hybridComposition.idempotence: Keys include root slot and nested component/step. Resume restores a committed result and continues its unfinished children, never applies history to reroll it or executes an event twice.
hybridComposition.budgets: Validate configured event budgets can support required chains. Current numerical limits are proposed; on required overflow fail configuration, never truncate the two-root sequence.

heavenlyIdentity.membership: God, Demigod, Angel, Utusan Tuhan, Pemuka Agama and Orang Saleh are user-defined entries in Heavenly Principle.
heavenlyIdentity.ancestryPolicy: Subtype selection does not select the main family again. Utusan/Pemuka/Orang Saleh are user-defined spiritual role entries in this family; they dispatch no Human, Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris or religion selector. Demigod runs no Hybrid, God parent event or Awakening unless separately authorized.
heavenlyIdentity.stagePolicy: Resolve all approved subtype/Concept/Divine events before main Archetype; preserve normal Size, five stats, Power/mastery, Apex and Title.
heavenlyIdentity.eventStatus: Approved profiles in heavenly-principle-events-design.json. Earlier domain/lineage/order/awakening/blessing templates have no active caller beyond these user-defined events.

Old Goku/Rimuru/Kaneki/Inuyasha/Ichigo/Naruto/Luffy selector is archived inactive; reference ancestry never auto-runs Hybrid.

human.narrationContext: Nggak ada yang spesial, cuma manusia biasa.

elf.behavior: React to Elf, spin/react to its type, record fixed grants or resolve one declared subtype wheel and react to its committed outcome, then continue to archetype. Power/weapon mastery is deferred to its normal main stage.
elf.additionalSubtypeEvents: Only the five declared follow-up wheels; fixed-grant types add no fake spin.
elf.traits: All eight event/grant profiles specified; power content drafted; balance pending.

dwarf.status: user-confirmed routing; disclosed count-weight typo interpretation and piece-weight default
dwarf.behavior: Spin/react to Dwarf or Gnome. Dwarf spins an armor count then exactly that many unique armor pieces; Gnome spins one technology weapon. Resolve each result and its context, then continue to archetype.

goblinoid.status: User-defined routing and ratios; creative pools and timing interpretations documented separately
goblinoid.behavior: Goblin spins army count then Bos/Kacung; Orc spins one weighted role and its immediate events/grants or stage tickets; Troll spins one condition with a mapped -1 point penalty. Continue to archetype after immediate events.

raksasa.status: User-confirmed base-race events and giant Size; Archetype skip accepted on 2026-10-09, replacing the former two-slot rule.
raksasa.behavior: Commit/react Raksasa and register existing deferred effects once → one base race spin with normal immediate/nested events → giant/base link → saved caller
raksasa.nextAfterRaceEffects: saved caller; Archetype only after outer race event is complete

fae.status: User-confirmed four subraces and fixed 4:2:3:1 odds; King +2 applies to all owned powers
fae.behavior: Select one Fairy subrace. Parents grants Wish; Pixie draws the one universal Element wheel and gains its manipulation power; Healer grants Healing; King queues one extra Power acquisition and registers +2 rank mastery on all owned powers. Finish immediate events before archetype.

beastfolk.countAndAnimalWeights: Exactly one animal spin from twelve approved types, equal base weights (1/12 before modifiers). No count wheel or additional type spin.

animalCountContract.unresolved: Source-backed Size reference, detailed equipment/ability limits and the future race-event executor.

baseForm.fullAnimalForm: Only the selected animal via Animal Transformation
baseForm.sizeReferencePolicy: Humanoid normal-body reference at global Size; source-backed numerical reference remains to be assigned.

lelembut.status: User-confirmed twelve local and six imported types/events; Skeleton/Zombie inherit origin events with previous race families excluded; equal base weights; detailed balance pending
lelembut.behavior: Commit type grants/tickets/penalties, react, resolve immediate type events; Skeleton/Zombie draw an unused source family and run its approved events as an origin component, preserving undead identity, then return.

mythical-beast.status: Ten Local and all eight Imported Mythical Beast event routes are defined. Griffin is user-specified; five remaining packages are authored within delegated three-point budget. Dragon/Phoenix and all earlier grants unchanged; detailed power/body/Size/odds balance pending.
mythical-beast.behavior: All ten Local profiles preserved. Dragon keeps form/+2/Element; Phoenix fixed two powers. Griffin Flight/Strength +1; five authored three-point fixed power/stat profiles fill the remaining Imported pool. Commit selected profile once, react, resolve only its declared children, restore exact saved caller.
mythical-beast.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for the ordinary main race-stage chain

golem.status: Seven user-defined material manipulation types; Rock/Magma +1, Crystal +2, Diamond +3 numeric Durability. Element Golem +1 shared Power Mastery. Equal base weights; detailed balance pending.
golem.behavior: Spin one of seven Golem types. Commit its material identity and approved fixed grants/modifiers, then react. Element Golem registers +1 shared Power Mastery, completes one universal Element spin and gains its canonical manipulation power once; restore saved caller.
golem.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for ordinary race-stage chain

elemental.status: User-confirmed one universal Element spin and its selected manipulation power. Elemental has no Power Mastery boost; Element roster and detailed balance remain pending.
elemental.behavior: Commit/react to Elemental family result, call element-universal exactly once, commit its selected element and linked power, react to that actual result, then restore the saved caller.
elemental.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for ordinary race-stage chain

symbiote.status: User-confirmed host race attachment plus existing Takeover/power thresholds; equal default odds and detailed balance pending.
symbiote.behavior: Commit/react Symbiote family; spin one host race and finish its approved immediate/nested events under shared history; restore Symbiote caller; spin Takeover once, commit source modifiers/react, resolve awarded Symbiote Power children, then saved caller.
symbiote.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for ordinary race-stage chain

heavenly-principle.status: Six user-defined subtypes, exact 1:1:2:2:3:3 odds and events; God 80% None on normal Power and Concept-only max mastery. Concept starter and detailed balance pending; Concept/Divine base weights equal.
heavenly-principle.behavior: Commit/react to family, spin one subtype at declared weights, commit subtype source effects and react, resolve declared child wheels sequentially with a reaction per result, then restore saved caller. God finishes follower-count after two Divine results, using stat-only god policy.
heavenly-principle.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for ordinary race-stage chain

demon.status: Five user-confirmed types/events and equal base odds; canonical twenty-outcome Demonic/Angelic routes. Follower/sin/Setan rewards unchanged; exact power roster authored editable.
demon.behavior: Commit/react to family; spin one equal subtype; commit source effects and react; resolve declared children, one actual spin/reaction per invocation; restore saved caller.
demon.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for normal race-stage chain

hybrid.status: User-confirmed two sequential race components with normal events and shared nested history.
hybrid.behavior: Hybrid result/reaction → component 1 result/reaction and complete immediate nested chain → component 2 result/reaction and complete immediate chain → record completion → saved caller. No fusion stability or dominance wheel.
hybrid.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; archetype for ordinary main race-stage chain

anime-lineage.status: Anime rename, Genre-before-Role, seven MC routes and Technician own-Tech scope user-confirmed. Delegated catalogs authored; vehicle classification and duplicate sampling disclosed working interpretations.
behavior: if MC resolve only committed genre profile and its actual children
anime-lineage.npc: Every Genre NPC retains Genre+Role only. No Cheat, Fantasy ticket, Romance ending/count, Sci-fi role, tech/mecha, Action Strength or Sport Speed event.
anime-lineage.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: saved caller; main archetype only after outer race tree complete

machine.status: Seven Machine types; Transformer Vehicle Shifting. Nanobot directly Shapeshifting; AI directly Digital Being/+2 Intelligence, Cyborg one weapon/+1 Intelligence, Android one power. Four new twelve-entry catalogs remain; Household twenty short-name weak linked powers. Body/Size and detailed limits pending.
behavior: commit actual Machine family to shared race history
one actual machine-type spin/reaction once its roster is approved
restore exact saved caller; main Archetype only after outer race tree completes
machine.activationRequirement: Future execution requires a nonempty approved type roster and an explicit approved profile per type, including an explicit no-event profile if desired. Missing profiles are configuration errors, never silent event skips or permission to execute proposals.
machine.directAIAndCyborgRules: No extra AI/Cyborg type spin; AI fixed power and +2 Intelligence, Cyborg +1 Intelligence plus exactly one weapon.
machine.directNanobotRule: Exactly one fixed Shapeshifting grant, zero additional model/subtype/acquisition spins.

transformerRule.timing: Mode commit → linked grant/binding → at most one already-active Shrek hook for the actual tagged mode spin → result context/reaction → saved caller.
transformerRule.idempotence: One fixed grant per actual Transformer type source. Retry restores the mode and grant; no duplicate power, mastery or hook. More mode bindings require later explicit authorization.
transformerRule.mastery: Retain after main None; use the one common Power Mastery. No power Enchant.
transformerRule.scope: Only the actual selected vehicle form; no separate owned vehicle, crew, built-in weapons, stat bonuses, automatic Flight power, extra Size or unlimited forms.
transformerRule.runtimeReadiness: Body/Size reference and detailed transformation limits remain pending.

primordial.status: Race and Champion budgets directly instructed; eleven working identities and lore recipes authored within delegation. Algorithm design, executor and body/capability/Size profiles remain configuration.
primordial.nextAfterDeclaredEvents: exact saved caller; then initial gate

dwarfArmor.requestedSpins: The committed armor-count result N requires exactly N actual armor-piece spins.
dwarfArmor.scope: One Dwarf armor-award event, identified by runId, event invocation, and component slot when applicable.
dwarfArmor.beforeEachDraw: Remove all chosen armor IDs from the eligible set, apply declared guards to remaining pieces, normalize remaining weights, and freeze this draw distribution.
dwarfArmor.commit: Atomically journal the result, append the chosen ID, grant its armor instance and one +1 numeric modifier, update remaining IDs, append context, then react.
dwarfArmor.repeatKey: Every scheduled draw has its own stable invocation ID and ordinal; do not share one consumed-event key across repeated draws.
dwarfArmor.duplicatePolicy: Chosen pieces always have effective weight zero. Weight modifiers cannot restore their eligibility. Never reroll a committed duplicate or substitute another result.
dwarfArmor.wheelRendering: Chosen sections are disabled and have zero sector angle in subsequent active wheels. Redistribute the active circle using remaining frozen probabilities; show collected pieces outside the active wheel if desired.
dwarfArmor.lastDrawPolicy: If N=5, the fifth scheduled piece spin still occurs with the sole remaining piece at 100%, then receives its own result/reaction. This is an explicit exception to the generic fixed-identity reveal shortcut.

pieceWeights.status: User-confirmed equal probability default for eligible armor pieces; preserve specified armor-count weights.
pieceWeights.reason: Equal active-piece base odds follow the user default. Remove selected pieces before normalizing; change the base distribution only if the user specifies an override before a draw.

dwarfArmor.poolExhaustion: Configuration error if requested remaining draws exceed eligible remaining unique pieces; do not truncate the awarded count or silently reuse a piece.
dwarfArmor.bonusUnits: Numeric points, following the established +1-point convention; numeric scales or explicit mappings required.
dwarfArmor.additionalStats: No unrequested material, quality, weight, durability, intelligence, or mobility effects are inferred.

gnomeTech.poolOrder: Catalog order only; no potency ranking requested.
gnomeTech.grant: Grant exactly one technology weapon instance from the selected result.
gnomeTech.mastery: Register unresolved Weapon Mastery and process it at the normal main Weapon stage, including when the main draw is None.
gnomeTech.existingGear: Keep the tech weapon alongside any later weapons; follow the shared owned-inventory and grant-provenance contract.
gnomeTech.powerBoundary: Effects produced by a technology weapon do not automatically grant a matching personal power.
gnomeTech.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
gnomeTech.theme: Gnome tinker gadgets based on clockwork, steam, springs, traps, lenses, alchemy, and decoys.
gnomeTech.weaponClassification: Direct attacks, traps, control devices, and tactical decoys all count as weapons under the user rule. A construct gadget includes its operating mechanism/controller in one weapon kit; it does not spawn extra weapon or power grants.
gnomeTech.masteryMeaning: Precision, timing, targeting, placement, and operation/control of the chosen gadget; actual mastery rank remains a later spin.
gnomeTech.sourcePolicy: Official sources support the broad tinkering/clockwork and mechanized-gnome themes. These twenty gadgets and combat functions are original game adaptations, not a list of canonical racial equipment.

goblinArmy.generalWeightsStatus: Reuse the same army-count wheel for Orc General as the working interpretation of its army spin.
goblinArmy.goblinOrder: Army count -> Bos/Kacung -> archetype. Both spins occur even when army count is 0.
goblinArmy.control: Goblin Bos and Orc General control the rolled count. Goblin Kacung belongs to the associated unit but controls 0 soldiers; do not present the unit as their personal army.
goblinArmy.zero: Bos with 0 has the boss title and an empty army; Kacung with 0 remains a valid comic result. Never reroll either.
goblinArmy.stats: Army size does not add to personal Strength, Speed, Durability, Intelligence, or Fight. Troop profiles and battle contribution need separate design.

orcStageBonuses.register: A role result records a stage bonus ticket with its source invocation and component slot; register each once.
orcStageBonuses.sequence: At the target stage: main acquisition spin and its immediate details -> each pending bonus acquisition spin and details -> mastery for every owned instance still unresolved -> eligible weapon enchantment -> next main stage.
orcStageBonuses.eligibility: Freeze fresh odds at each bonus spin using current build/declared eligible pool. Do not carry a race-stage frozen weapon/power draw.
orcStageBonuses.idempotence: Consume the ticket when its bonus result commits; resuming cannot create a second spin or erase earlier grants.

warrior.emptyOutcomePolicy: Exclude None/no-weapon results before drawing because the user requests an extra weapon. Error if no eligible weapon remains.

shaman.emptyOutcomePolicy: The extra spin uses the normal Power outcome rules, including None if the approved pool allows it. The request guarantees a spin, not an extra power regardless of result.

orcStageBonuses.lateActivation: If a role ticket is acquired after its target stage, dispatch its acquisition/mastery subflow from the current caller and return; never restart the main sequence.

shrek.strongestProfile: Shrek is the intended strongest Orc-wheel profile through repeat five-stat growth. Actual final rolls and mastery remain independent.

hook.status: user-confirmed repeat bonus per funny spin
hook.activeWhen: Character owns the active Shrek Power profile
hook.qualifies: A later actual committed spin outcome has the catalog mechanics tag funny-result.
hook.start: Only results after Shrek Power acquisition; no acquisition bonus or retroactive bonus.
hook.timing: After applying the committed outcome, apply this hook before making its reaction/context snapshot.
hook.consumptionKey: runId + hookId + qualifying spin invocation ID
hook.repeat: Once for every distinct qualifying spin, even across several later stages. Re-rendering, fixed reveals, memes, captions, and repeated evaluation do not count as new spins.
hook.powerMastery: The user-defined passive point reward is active on acquisition; Power Mastery still resolves later and does not silently change the +1 reward.
hook.loopPolicy: The hook adds five modifiers, not another spin; its own modifiers cannot trigger it again.
hook.truth: A narrator saying an outcome is funny cannot add the mechanics tag or activate this hook.

funnyWeaponPool.placementStatus: Design interpretation: use this funny pool for the normal main Weapon spin when Shrek is active; do not manufacture a separate race-stage spin.
funnyWeaponPool.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.

shrek.otherFunnySpins: Any later catalog-tagged funny-result spin can qualify, not just this weapon pool. Other funny entries need explicit approved tags.

troll.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
troll.penalty: Each selected condition adds exactly one -1 numeric-point modifier to its mapped main stat.
troll.timing: Record disease and modifier once at its result; apply against later base stats with the configured stat scale bounds.
troll.weaknessStage: Keep the normal later Weakness spin. This race condition does not consume that stage.
troll.mappingScope: These penalties are game rules rather than medical advice or measurements.

sharedWheelContract.scope: One canonical wheel for each theme, shared by all races, characters, archetypes, events, and other approved callers. Do not combine all themes into one mega-pool.
sharedWheelContract.grant: Only the selected one power; no bundle of lower-ranked options.
sharedWheelContract.caller: Caller guard determines access only. Record real source family, subtype, stage, sourceSpinId, componentSlot, and return continuation; selecting a power does not change race.
sharedWheelContract.odds: A canonical theme uses the same definitions and base weights for every caller. Only declared approved modifiers may alter conditional odds; no caller-specific copy.
sharedWheelContract.mastery: Early grants remain owned and unresolved until main Power Mastery. None removes no earlier grant; power mastery never creates enchantment.
sharedWheelContract.rank: Relative potential is not mastery, rarity, main stats, or Apex Force.
sharedWheelContract.sourceAuthority: Power descriptions are authored game capacities, not franchise packages or scientific claims.
sharedWheelContract.registry: Race design imports each wheel by canonical ID. Definitions and outcomes exist only here; importing references are not duplicate active wheels.
sharedWheelContract.weights: Equal base weight 1: twenty-outcome themes each 5% per outcome, four outcomes per tier (20% per tier). Other twelve-outcome themes each 1/12. Only explicit approved modifiers change conditional odds; tier ordering adds no rarity.
sharedWheelContract.symbioteDraws: power-symbiote grants one selected power per invocation. Symbiote 80/90% schedules one invocation, 100% schedules two sequential invocations, each with its own actual spin, grant, reaction and source ordinal. Takeover stat stacking is governed by the separate Symbiote event contract.
sharedWheelContract.divineDraws: One power per actual invocation. God two Divine; Pemuka Agama one Divine; Apostle God one Divine. Angel two Angelic; Priest/Bishop/Fallen Angel one Angelic each. Ordinary common mastery; God maximum remains actual Concept Authority only.

demonicAccess.status: Canonical independent Demonic wheel, user-requested; former Cursed display-alias interpretation retired.
demonicAccess.policy: One selected power per actual sequential invocation; same canonical pool/base weights, true source provenance, no None or uniqueness reroll.

fairyPowerMastery.status: User confirmed +2 applies to every owned power; rank-step interpretation and final scale remain design details
fairyPowerMastery.unit: ordered mastery rank steps (proposed interpretation; final rank scale pending)
fairyPowerMastery.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
fairyPowerMastery.formula: sharedEffectiveRankIndex = sharedRolledRankIndex + 2 + sum(other distinct active all-owned mastery bonuses)
fairyPowerMastery.scale: Use a configured ordered rank scale, never main-stat numeric units. Rank labels and maximum remain pending.
fairyPowerMastery.provenance: Committed Fairy King source modifier and the one shared character mastery invocation; individual power grants retain their own provenance.
fairyPowerMastery.idempotence: A distinct source modifier changes the shared rank once. Owning more powers, reevaluation and media retries do not multiply +2.
fairyPowerMastery.inventory: No owned power means no mastery roll or phantom power. Keep the main and extra acquisition stages even when the modifier is registered.
fairyPowerMastery.enchantment: Never opens enchantment; this affects Power Mastery only.
fairyPowerMastery.baseResult: Keep rolled mastery unchanged and show rolled-to-effective rank in context/final card.
fairyPowerMastery.scopeSource: User answered: Semua power yang dimiliki
fairyPowerMastery.qualifies: The common character Power Mastery and its ordinary projections cover all acquired powers; an actual God Authority uses its source-bound base9 plus shared final modifiers, never transferred by matching definition.
fairyPowerMastery.lateActivation: Register new source as pending. Before final phase do not project; within final phase refresh from the same retained immutable base plus current distinct sources, preserving God instance overrides. No mastery redraw or compounded bonus.
fairyPowerMastery.stacking: This fixed Fairy King modifier is active once per character; replaying the same source or repeating evaluation cannot make +4/+6. Additional independent mastery modifiers require their own declared stacking rules.

silumanAnimalPool.theme: Animals associated with keramat, Siluman, folklore, and Indonesian cultural motifs, with familiar imported fantasy references allowed.
silumanAnimalPool.origins: Reference metadata only; no new Lokal/Impor selector.
silumanAnimalPool.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
silumanAnimalPool.mechanics: One shared Animal Transformation comes from the explicit user rule. Reference motifs alone add no other powers, numeric points, or source-character identity.
silumanAnimalPool.size: All twelve Siluman normal humanoid height profiles are declared in Size design. Full animal transformed states remain separate; never substitute animal length/wingspan into normal humanoid height.
silumanAnimalPool.status: All twelve animal choices user-confirmed; one per character
silumanAnimalPool.animalSpecificGrant: Babi grants Nyolong from lelembut-events-design.json per siluman-babi-nyolong. Other animals retain shared Animal Transformation only until more explicit rules are supplied.

lelembutPools.status: User-confirmed twelve local and six imported types/events; Skeleton/Zombie inherit origin events with previous race families excluded; equal base weights; detailed balance pending
lelembutPools.definitionAuthority: Inline subtypeWheel definitions under Lelembut family in content/race-wheel-design.json
lelembutPools.weights: Lokal/Impor have equal base weights (50/50); each eligible local or imported subtype also has base weight 1. Equal odds apply per wheel, so differently sized subtype pools have different unconditional leaf probabilities.
lelembutPools.typeSelection: Spin the selected origin subtype wheel, commit identity and declared effects, react, resolve its immediate event plan, then return.
lelembutPools.classification: Game ghost/undead/occult/urban-legend grouping, not a unified folklore taxonomy.
lelembutPools.familyBoundary: Babi Ngepet is represented by Siluman Babi with Nyolong; Werewolf by Siluman Serigala. Garuda/Barong remain Mythical Beast. Undead origin and Vampire prey use explicit reference roles, not an implicit main-sequence restart.
lelembutPools.context: Selected type plus actual grants/tickets/modifiers and subsequent results accumulate with source/component provenance; optional source themes add no extra effects.
lelembutPools.size: Current terminal normal-form Lelembut profiles are declared with height/length/diameter/manifestation semantics. Skeleton/Zombie reuse their actual completed origin body; no implicit Human fallback.
lelembutPools.sourceInheritance: User-confirmed source race and inherited source events; previous character race families excluded.

raceNoRepeat.status: User-confirmed global no-repeat history, including every nested family in the first Hybrid chain before its second draw.
raceNoRepeat.scope: Every character-identity race draw: main, Hybrid roots, Symbiote host, Raksasa base, Skeleton/Zombie origin, Mutant mutation root and every nested mutation identity draw.
raceNoRepeat.key: Canonical selectionFamilyId / option.familyId; enforce at the level selected by the race-family wheel.
raceNoRepeat.state: raceSelectionHistory[] and usedRaceFamilyIds[] shared by the whole character across all origin/parent branches.
raceNoRepeat.initial: The first main race result is committed to history before its subtype or other race events run. Selecting Skeleton/Zombie therefore already marks Lelembut used.
raceNoRepeat.beforeDraw: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
raceNoRepeat.weights: Use user-specified weights where present, otherwise base weight 1. Apply approved modifiers and normalize over eligible positive weights. All previously selected race families have probability zero; exclusion dominates modifiers.
raceNoRepeat.commit: Atomically append invocation/role/family/component provenance and add the selected family to usedRaceFamilyIds before dispatching any child race events. Nested descendants use the same character history, never a copied/reset per-component set.
raceNoRepeat.resume: A resumed committed invocation reuses its result. It does not apply the exclusion to itself and reroll; history and consumed-event keys restore atomically.
raceNoRepeat.bounded: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (19 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
raceNoRepeat.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
raceNoRepeat.subtypes: Selecting a subtype/form is resolving the already-selected family, not selecting that family again. Known lore ancestry is not added to history unless it was actually selected by an identity race wheel.
raceNoRepeat.referenceBoundary: Vampire prey is a reference to a target, not a character race acquisition; it keeps its existing separate reference contract and does not consume personal race history.
raceNoRepeat.archetypeBoundary: Initial eligibility is evaluated once after the complete initial Race tree. Mutant may subsequently acquire a new race during its Archetype event using the same global history. Preserve the frozen pre-mutation gate/result; mutation children restore the saved Mutant caller and never re-enter the gate. Initial Raksasa skips; mutation-acquired Raksasa keeps giant Size but does not revoke the selected Mutant. Older committed journals retain their original policy.
raceNoRepeat.example: Hybrid → Symbiote → Raksasa → Abyssal Axiom commits hybrid/symbiote/raksasa/demon. The second Hybrid draw excludes all four (plus any earlier history), leaving 15 of 19 if all other options are eligible.

mythicalBeastPools.status: Ten Local and all eight Imported Mythical Beast event routes are defined. Griffin is user-specified; five remaining packages are authored within delegated three-point budget. Dragon/Phoenix and all earlier grants unchanged; detailed power/body/Size/odds balance pending.
mythicalBeastPools.definitionAuthority: Inline Mythical Beast subtype wheels in content/race-wheel-design.json
mythicalBeastPools.originStatus: Lokal/Impor split remains a proposed reference selector.
mythicalBeastPools.localMeaning: Indonesian story, temple-art or regional cultural reference, including localized Hindu-Buddhist motifs; not necessarily an exclusively Indonesian origin or traditional biological race.
mythicalBeastPools.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization. Optional form/legacy selectors remain inactive proposals.
mythicalBeastPools.events: Ten Local profiles and seven Imported fixed profiles live in mythical-beast-events-design.json. Dragon keeps its separate eight-form/+2/Element route. All Imported events are filled; optional Barong/Naga selectors stay inactive. Package budget is accounting metadata only.
mythicalBeastPools.familyBoundary: Ordinary keramat animal references remain Siluman. Named Mythical Beast composites do not dispatch Siluman/Hybrid/Heavenly/Legendary events automatically.
mythicalBeastPools.size: All current beast types and eight Dragon forms have explicit editable normal body Size profiles. Costume/performer/temple sculpture dimensions are not creature-body canon; no wingspan as height.

barong.label: Barong (Bali)
barong.formSelectorStatus: Optional reference proposal; no active caller in the current approved local event plan.

reog.label: Reog (Jawa)
reog.visualContext: Wajah lebar, rujukan kepala harimau dan bulu merak

classificationContract.rule: Barong Bali and Reog Jawa are separate primary local type choices. Reog is excluded from the Balinese Barong form selector. No event or gameplay effect follows merely from this classification.

mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.status: Minimum Master user-confirmed; constrained scheduled draw is the working algorithm realization.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.target: Only the weapon instance granted by the actual Kinnara type result; no guarantee for unrelated main/bonus weapons.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.selection: Before the instrument scheduled mastery draw, intersect ordinary eligible outcomes with rankIndex >= configured Master index. Preserve positive declared weights, then normalize and freeze the surviving odds.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.weights: Use user-specified normal Weapon Mastery rank weights if present, otherwise base weight 1 per eligible rank. Apply the Master-or-higher constraint before normalization; keep one actual scheduled spin.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.emptyPool: Missing configured Master rank, invalid weights, or no eligible positive rank at/above Master is a configuration error. Missing/null uncommitted base weights use 1; do not bypass another guard or silently grant Master.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.scheduledSpin: Perform exactly one actual scheduled mastery spin for the instrument, even if only one result survives at 100%; record and react to the real outcome.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.base: Commit the actual allowed base result. Never roll a low rank then reroll, overwrite it, or add another mastery spin.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.enchantment: The granted instrument is enchantable. After its Master-or-higher result, schedule the ordinary compatible enchantment flow when its slot is available; preserve the normal acquisition/result/reaction and consumed-slot contracts.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.mainWeapon: Keep the main Weapon spin and any authorized bonus acquisitions; None does not remove this owned instrument.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.lateGrant: A later authorized Kinnara component acquisition opens the ordinary pending owned-weapon subflow and returns to its saved caller.
mythicalBeastWeaponMastery.identity: Alat Musik is a fixed generic weapon grant. Instrument model/profile remains pending; no instrument-choice wheel or sound/music power is added.

abyssalAxiom.label: Abyssal Axiom
abyssalAxiom.status: Five user-confirmed types/events and equal base odds; canonical twenty-outcome Demonic/Angelic routes. Follower/sin/Setan rewards unchanged; exact power roster authored editable.

legendarySelection.status: User requests Imported boosts, Japan count ten and other-story additions. Chosen ten/eight replacements and per-hero packages are authored editable curation; origin 65:35/direct-character unchanged.
sequence: Spin one named character from only the selected origin wheel
Commit actual reference and explicit fixed package once; react
Restore saved caller; continue normal main sequence
legendarySelection.characterProbability: Equal weight 1 per eligible character: thirty Local (1/30), eighty Imported (1/80). Origin fixed Local 65% / Imported 35%.
legendarySelection.categoryPolicy: Source kinds and franchise groups are metadata, not extra selectors.
legendarySelection.upgradesStatus: Every Imported has a four-point package. Six retained packages now use source-scoped mastery; eight non-Japanese additions replace eight Japanese. Weapon +1 only exact owned grant instance; power +1 one shared current/future rank. Thirty Local unchanged, detailed limits pending.
legendarySelection.scope: Preserve all existing main families, all previous event contracts, shared race history, nested returns, main stages and one shared Power Mastery.

importedReferencePolicy.userDirection: Historical and traditional figures appearing in Fate; many characters permitted
importedReferencePolicy.identityPolicy: One person/reference identity per outcome; aliases, class, Alter/Summer/age variants do not add duplicates. Existing Local Arjuna/Karna/Rama are not repeated in Imported.
importedReferencePolicy.classificationPolicy: Keep historical/traditional basis, fictional Fate interpretation/vessel and authored package separate. These metadata do not spin additional categories or dispatch Anime/Archetype/Race.
importedReferencePolicy.supersedes: Prior one-representative-per-Imported-franchise policy and twenty modern fictional Imported profiles; preserved inactive in history.
importedReferencePolicy.boostPolicy: Every Imported profile has one explicit four-point package; fixed grants/modifiers commit once. Catalogue revisions do not double old and new package rewards or alter historical committed spins.
importedReferencePolicy.masteryPolicy: Owned signature weapon +1 only on actual granted instance/kit; Power Mastery +1 on one shared current/future value, without numeric clamps and with source dedup. No new mastery spin or Power Enchant.

subflow.operation: Complete all prior mandatory Title/late events, raw stat/mastery slots and Resilient retries; keep numeric bonuses pending.
Project active per-weapon and one common power effective rank from retained raw bases and distinct sources without numeric clamps; preserve God instance override.
For each active compatible weapon, effective>=5 and unused slot -> actual Enchant spin/events; otherwise record final skip reason. All child results/reactions complete.

Complete authorized late acquisitions/raw masteries/retries and source hooks. If inventory/modifier fingerprint changed, return to calculate-effective-masteries and check only unused slots, respecting event limits.
Once no mandatory child/gate remains, audit Pawn and Lucky Number, settle Lucky modifier once, sum all five main-stat bonus/debuff ledgers against resolved bases without numeric clamps.
Audit consistent final masteries/Enchant slots/stats/provenance, then freeze and generate image/final card.

conditionalModel.formula: P(size|context) ∝ P_prior(size)^priorStrength × product(P(context_group|size)^effectiveStrength) × explicit factors; normalize on hard-eligible support.
conditionalModel.modelClass: Discrete conditional Bayesian/tempered likelihood model; strength1 is the declared ordinary Bayesian update. Lore likelihood parameters are authored, not validated probabilities of real-world observations.
conditionalModel.raceComposition: One specific prior per owned body identity; mixture over the same metric or explicit per-profile principal-extent projection for mixed metrics. Explicit all-source body profile wins; no hidden Human fallback.
conditionalModel.mixtureFormula: P_prior(size) = sum(normalizedRaceInfluence_j * P_j(size)); union of whole-number supports, no multiplying contradictory absolute-body densities.
conditionalModel.dependencies: Subtype already encoded in selected prior is not treated as an independent observation again. One most-specific rule per dependency group; equal-specificity ties need configuration. Explicit interaction=true is a conditional joint correction, not a duplicate independent clue.
conditionalModel.evidenceScope: Canonical committed owner family/results/Archetype IDs only. External troops/prey/mentors/equipment and future uncommitted spins are not context evidence.
conditionalModel.display: Condition the full finite candidate distribution first, then approximate at most12 readable whole-number sectors by posterior quantiles/nearest bins. Sum assigned mass; preserve full posterior and projection mapping. Single12-point profile remains unchanged.
conditionalModel.equalizer: Override final displayed hard-eligible sectors to uniform; suppress soft lore bias, preserve physical support/guards.
conditionalModel.numerics: Log-space likelihood normalization avoids product underflow; reject contradictory all-zero likelihood unless Equalizer suppresses soft bias.
conditionalModel.giant: Raksasa fixes abnormal support of eight milestones. Default prior1/8; only explicitly scoped giant evidence/factors can change odds. Initial lore rules are normal-only.
conditionalModel.calibration: Selected lore centers and explicit user-authorized normal-form intervals for complete current identity coverage. Broad widths, mixture/conditional strengths and principal-extent projection remain authored; not empirical population probabilities.
conditionalModel.freeze: Save context sources, all component priors, model/version/parameters, applied/skipped rules, full posterior, display projection and final odds before one external draw; no reroll or model update on replay.
conditionalModel.legacy: probabilityModel:null deliberately selects archived-style range planning; committed0.2 plans continue resolving unchanged.

Freeze uncapped and final play distribution separately.

Evaluate matching immediate event rules and newly opened unlocks; schedule in stable priority/ID order.
Resolve each scheduled event through the same spin procedure, depth-first, with a saved return continuation.
After mandatory child events finish, resume the caller or advance to the next main stage.

earlyGrantContract.idempotence: The same committed result and component slot applies its grants once; retries do not duplicate a power, weapon, armor piece, or linked numeric stat modifier.
earlyGrantContract.masteryTiming: Before normal stages defer the single shared Power Mastery for ordinary power grants. The fixed God Concept Authority maximum applies on its actual grant without another mastery draw; weapon grants retain ordinary per-weapon mastery.
earlyGrantContract.mainWheelPolicy: Main weapon and power spins remain. A None result adds nothing and does not delete an earlier grant.

earlyGrantContract.weaponGate: After permitted main/bonus acquisitions/details resolve all active owned raw Weapon Mastery slots with exact-instance minimum guards and optional Resilient retry, including retained early weapons after None. Register pending final bonus/Enchant gate; apply Technician/other matching bonuses only at final phase before compatible effective Master>=5 check. Gladiator discarded weapons are inactive and its exclusive weapon lock blocks extra grants.
earlyGrantContract.lateGrant: A late weapon resolves its own authorized mastery/enchantment subflow. A late power inherits shared mastery; if there has never been a mastery spin and the scheduled stage was empty, the first late power opens the one shared draw. Restore the saved caller.
earlyGrantContract.duplicateDefinitionPolicy: Existing instance/provenance rules apply; exact repeated-definition merge or exclusion policy remains pending. Never reroll a committed duplicate result.
earlyGrantContract.gnomeGadgetRule: Direct attacks, traps, control devices, and tactical decoys all count as weapons under the user rule. A construct gadget includes its operating mechanism/controller in one weapon kit; it does not spawn extra weapon or power grants.
earlyGrantContract.universalPowerRule: All Holy/Cursed/Blood/Cosmic/Symbiote/Divine/Demonic/Angelic grants reference canonical definitions, retain actual caller and use source-owned power and one common mastery timing.
earlyGrantContract.universalElementRule: Element Pixie grants one canonical elemental manipulation power. Fire is the same definition used by Summer Fey Elf; caller source/season remains separate from intrinsic power. Banaspati grants the same Fire Manipulation directly without an Element selector or Summer identity.

earlyGrantContract.lelembutRule: Retain all selected fixed and Cursed grants for normal Power Mastery; source/feeding reference spins do not grant unselected races or powers.
earlyGrantContract.golemRule: Retain one material/selected-element manipulation grant from the actual Golem result, including after main Power None. Use shared character Power Mastery. Fixed type grants create no extra acquisition spin. Element Golem additionally registers its +1 shared-rank modifier once at type commitment; no other Golem type or generic Element caller receives it.
earlyGrantContract.elementalRule: Keep selected elemental power after main Power None. It participates in the one shared character mastery; late grants inherit an existing rank. Normal main Weapon/Power acquisitions remain.
earlyGrantContract.symbioteRule: Preserve selected Symbiote powers after main Power None. Complete all acquisitions before the one shared mastery draw; existing shared rank is inherited by late grants. Takeover grants no mastery boost or Enchant.
earlyGrantContract.heavenlyRule: Retain all Concept, Divine, Angelic and communication grants after main Power None. Main Weapon/Power stages remain. Finish acquisitions before the one shared mastery spin; God Authority alone has an explicit effective-rank maximum override.
earlyGrantContract.abyssalRule: All powers remain after main Power None. Ordinary grants use one shared Power Mastery, including late grants; acquisition count never multiplies mastery draws.
earlyGrantContract.animeRule: Keep all actual Cheat, Tech and distinct Girlfriend grants after main None. Tech/Girlfriend use ordinary per-weapon mastery; Cheat uses one shared Power Mastery. Mecha is a separate vehicle record and grants no personal weapon/power by implication.
earlyGrantContract.survivalistRule: Direct environment-linked ordinary power after chance is retained after main None under common mastery, with no other caller event/theme selector. Apply upper-band +1 stat and power together once from the saved chance source.
earlyGrantContract.archaeologistRule: Fixed intrinsic finding-linked power grants; no additional Power/Element/Cosmic selector. Bind discovery animal as visual/theme provenance, without powers/stats from other animals or unapproved transformations. Powers persist after main Power None and use one ordinary shared Power Mastery; no rank boost, Authority override or Enchant. Apply the declared numeric modifiers once after immutable main-stat bases without numeric clamps; do not add the budget value separately.
earlyGrantContract.tamerRule: Companion and Taming Power survive main Weapon/Power None. Taming Power counts for the one shared ordinary owner Power Mastery. Companion does not itself schedule owner mastery; companion leveling/mastery/bonding wheels remain undefined. Register one separate companion entity, and grant the owner exactly one explicit Taming Power. Companion skills remain separate; no copied race/stat/weapon/mastery/enchant package or additional owner power from companion identity.
earlyGrantContract.alchemistRule: The one selected potion is consumed once. An actual power elixir grants its linked canonical power once at dose ordinal 1. Preserve after main None; normal one shared mastery, no extra selector/stat/Enchant. No quantity wheel or second potion.

earlyGrantContract.riderRule: All sixteen strong outcomes count as one owned weapon each when actually selected, including animals and unusual mounts. Link weapon instance to the same mount instance; no second entity or weapon acquisition selector. Retain after main Weapon None and resolve its one ordinary per-instance mastery at the normal Weapon stage. Effective Master or above opens compatible Enchant under existing rules; compatibility profiles remain configuration. Weak/moderate mounts grant no weapon or weapon mastery.
earlyGrantContract.priestRule: Retain owned power after normal main Power None. It participates in the one ordinary shared character Power Mastery at its normal stage; no God Concept Authority maximum and no power-mastery Enchant or extra mastery draw.
earlyGrantContract.goliathRule: Only Berserker grants Uncontrollable Rage once, independently owned and retained through the normal later Weakness spin. Not Berserker grants no Goliath weakness and does not remove any previously owned weakness. No invented numeric debuff, severity/activation draw or penalty.

Return to saved caller; late grants reuse the settled raw base. Only final bonus phase computes all-owned effective common rank, source-once under the signed, unbounded score policy; Power Mastery never schedules Enchant.

sourceRaceContract.status: User-confirmed source race and inherited source events; previous character race families excluded.
sourceRaceContract.pool: Reference the active canonical main race wheel, intersect caller guards and race-family-no-repeat, then normalize remaining declared weights.
sourceRaceContract.record: Keep Skeleton/Zombie as the undead identity. Add a scoped origin component and source family to the shared character race-selection history; retain actual family/selection-kind/spin provenance.
sourceRaceContract.executionStatus: Inheritance and non-repetition decisions settled. Full executable configuration still needs the ordinary unresolved catalog weights, size profiles, scales and family event details.
sourceRaceContract.returnPoint: After inherited immediate events, restore saved caller; race-stage root returns to archetype. Deferred stage effects remain queued.
sourceRaceContract.eventInheritance: Dispatch the selected family complete approved subtype and event plan once as an inherited origin component. Fixed grants, modifiers, hooks and deferred stage tickets use their own canonical contracts and caller return; do not invent unresolved family content.
dispatchOrder: commit origin result and shared race history atomically
record inherited origin component while preserving undead identity
react to the origin result using committed facts
dispatch the origin family approved subtype/events with scoped provenance
resolve immediate child reactions; keep deferred tickets for normal stages
sourceRaceContract.provenance: Each inherited family owns a componentId and source origin invocation; carry root undead componentId and parent componentId through child events. Consumed keys prevent replay from dispatching twice.
sourceRaceContract.sizeAndArchetype: An inherited Raksasa binds giant Size and makes the final character skip Archetype under policy 1.0.0. Retain undead identity and all origin grants; other origins use explicit body profiles without a Human fallback.

preyContract.question: Ras mangsa?
preyContract.status: Requested race-wheel feeding preference; reference-only dispatch is a disclosed interpretation.
preyContract.pool: Use the canonical active main race wheel with base weight 1 per family unless user-specified, then apply this reference caller guards and approved modifiers. Freeze fresh actual odds without acquiring the prey race or consuming personal race history.
preyContract.record: Store prey selection family, selection kind, source invocation and Vampire component separately from personal identity.
sequence: power-cursed only when victim count is 1000
preyContract.zeroVictims: Retain the earlier prey result and its reaction even if count is zero; do not reroll or erase it.
preyContract.ownership: The prey selection does not grant its powers, race events, traits or owned units.
preyContract.returnPoint: After victim-count and eligible Cursed reaction, return to saved caller; race-stage caller returns to archetype.

feedingContract.bonusRule: 0/1/5/10: no bonus. 100: +1 each of five stats. 1000: +1 each of five stats and exactly one canonical Cursed spin.
feedingContract.exclusiveOutcomes: Use only the effects of the committed outcome. 1000 does not also apply a separate 100-tier bonus; total is +1 each, not +2.
feedingContract.provenance: feedingHistory[] per Vampire source component; victim count is backstory context and does not spawn owned army units.
feedingContract.returnPoint: After victim-count and eligible Cursed reaction, return to saved caller; race-stage caller returns to archetype.

statGuaranteeContract.status: Maximum guarantee user-confirmed; maximum base-result realization is a disclosed design interpretation.
statGuaranteeContract.maximumSource: Declared maximum outcome in the configured base Durability scale; no literal maximum is invented.
statGuaranteeContract.selection: At the scheduled Durability stage intersect all declared eligibility constraints with the maximum base outcome. Empty intersection is a configuration conflict; never bypass a forbidden guard.
statGuaranteeContract.scheduledSpin: Perform the actual normal Durability spin even if the constrained pool has one outcome at 100%; preserve invocation, frozen odds, result, and reaction.
statGuaranteeContract.base: Store the maximum as the actual immutable rolled base outcome, not a post-roll replacement or an infinite numeric value.
statGuaranteeContract.ledger: Later flat bonuses/penalties remain separate and use ordinary final-stat bounds. Whether the guarantee must override later penalties is not specified; base-maximum is the current proposal.
statGuaranteeContract.idempotence: Register once per committed source component. Multiple sources refer to the same scheduled maximum constraint and create no extra Durability spin.
statGuaranteeContract.lateActivation: If acquired after Durability, retain the committed base and flag the late-guarantee resolution as pending design. Do not silently reroll or replace it.
statGuaranteeContract.context: At Lich selection report a future Durability maximum guarantee, not an already rolled value; reveal the actual maximum value only at Durability.

silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.status: Nyolong power requested for Babi Ngepet; routing through accepted Siluman Babi is a disclosed interpretation.
silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.trigger: committed Babi animal result for this Siluman race component
silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.idempotence: One Nyolong grant per source Siluman component with Babi; consume runId/ruleId/sourceSilumanComponentId atomically. Additional animal results or retries do not duplicate this grant.
silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.timing: Attach the fixed grant to the actual Babi result reaction; no new wheel. Animal Transformation remains a separate completion grant.
silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.definitionAuthority: lelembut-events-design.json; same Nyolong definition as Tuyul
silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.mainPowerNone: Retain this owned power and resolve pending normal Power Mastery.
silumanAnimalSpecificGrantContracts.laterBabi: If another Babi component for the same Siluman component is allowed later, retain the original grant and add provenance/binding; no mastery respin.

raceNoRepeatContract.status: User-confirmed global no-repeat history, including every nested family in the first Hybrid chain before its second draw.
raceNoRepeatContract.scope: Every character-identity race draw: main, Hybrid roots, Symbiote host, Raksasa base, Skeleton/Zombie origin, Mutant mutation root and every nested mutation identity draw.
raceNoRepeatContract.key: Canonical selectionFamilyId / option.familyId; enforce at the level selected by the race-family wheel.
raceNoRepeatContract.state: raceSelectionHistory[] and usedRaceFamilyIds[] shared by the whole character across all origin/parent branches.
raceNoRepeatContract.initial: The first main race result is committed to history before its subtype or other race events run. Selecting Skeleton/Zombie therefore already marks Lelembut used.
raceNoRepeatContract.beforeDraw: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
raceNoRepeatContract.weights: Use user-specified weights where present, otherwise base weight 1. Apply approved modifiers and normalize over eligible positive weights. All previously selected race families have probability zero; exclusion dominates modifiers.
raceNoRepeatContract.commit: Atomically append invocation/role/family/component provenance and add the selected family to usedRaceFamilyIds before dispatching any child race events. Nested descendants use the same character history, never a copied/reset per-component set.
raceNoRepeatContract.resume: A resumed committed invocation reuses its result. It does not apply the exclusion to itself and reroll; history and consumed-event keys restore atomically.
raceNoRepeatContract.bounded: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (19 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
raceNoRepeatContract.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
raceNoRepeatContract.subtypes: Selecting a subtype/form is resolving the already-selected family, not selecting that family again. Known lore ancestry is not added to history unless it was actually selected by an identity race wheel.
raceNoRepeatContract.referenceBoundary: Vampire prey is a reference to a target, not a character race acquisition; it keeps its existing separate reference contract and does not consume personal race history.
raceNoRepeatContract.archetypeBoundary: Initial eligibility is evaluated once after the complete initial Race tree. Mutant may subsequently acquire a new race during its Archetype event using the same global history. Preserve the frozen pre-mutation gate/result; mutation children restore the saved Mutant caller and never re-enter the gate. Initial Raksasa skips; mutation-acquired Raksasa keeps giant Size but does not revoke the selected Mutant. Older committed journals retain their original policy.
raceNoRepeatContract.example: Hybrid → Symbiote → Raksasa → Abyssal Axiom commits hybrid/symbiote/raksasa/demon. The second Hybrid draw excludes all four (plus any earlier history), leaving 15 of 19 if all other options are eligible.

golemPowerMasteryModifierContract.status: User-confirmed +1 Power Mastery for Element Golem only; uses the established one shared character rank.
golemPowerMasteryModifierContract.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
golemPowerMasteryModifierContract.qualifies: The one shared character Power Mastery record and all current/future owned powers referring to it.
golemPowerMasteryModifierContract.emptyInventory: No owned power means no mastery draw or phantom power. The modifier does not generate another Power acquisition.
golemPowerMasteryModifierContract.cap: No numeric final floor/cap; raw mastery0..9 remains separate.
golemPowerMasteryModifierContract.callerGuard: Only an actual committed element-golem type result. The universal Element wheel and Elemental race do not grant this modifier.

godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.status: User-confirmed maximum mastery for the actual Concept Authority granted to God; explicit exception to ordinary shared effective-rank projection.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.target: Only the authority power instance created by the actual God Concept result for this source God component.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.timing: Attach on the actual Concept grant before its reaction. Symbolic maximum is available immediately; resolve its exact value from the configured rank scale.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.formula: powerEffectiveMasteryRankIndex = masteryScale.maxIndex for a matching active God Authority override; otherwise sharedEffectiveMasteryRankIndex
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.sharedBase: Retain the one common base/reference if available. This fixed per-instance override creates no sampled result, extra mastery spin or mastery reaction.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.ordinaryPowers: God Divine Power, normal Power and other grants use the ordinary shared rank unless independently granted as an explicitly overridden God Concept Authority.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.projectionGuard: Reprojecting common bonuses or late grants never replaces an Authority maximum with a lower shared rank. Maximum does not transfer by matching concept/definition alone.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.duplicatePolicy: Deduplicate the same source grant on replay. Authority-mode and ordinary concept-power grants remain distinct source instances; never merge them in a way that transfers the max override.
godAuthorityMasteryOverrideContract.limits: Maximum is the top of the configured mastery scale, not unlimited range, all concepts, all powers, or max main stats.

godNormalPowerScarcityContract.status: User-confirmed normal Power result split: 80% None, 20% a power.
godNormalPowerScarcityContract.activation: An actual committed God subtype source. Register source once; multiple references/replays do not multiply the 80% failure mass.
godNormalPowerScarcityContract.target: Later normal Power acquisition wheel: main stage and authorized normal-pool bonus acquisitions whose guard permits None.
godNormalPowerScarcityContract.excluded: God Concept, all Divine/themed event calls, fixed grants, direct title rewards and acquisitions explicitly guaranteed to exclude None are unaffected.

distribution.powerConditionalOdds: After all declared eligible-power guards and modifiers, normalize the remaining positive non-None weights within the 20% group.

godNormalPowerScarcityContract.resolution: One actual normal Power spin with this final odds snapshot. No preliminary success/failure wheel or reroll. Main None never removes owned Authority/Divine/fixed powers.
godNormalPowerScarcityContract.validation: For an applicable normal draw require an eligible configured None result and at least one eligible non-None positive weight. Unspecified base weights use 1; missing pools or invalid/zero-total eligible weights are configuration errors.
godNormalPowerScarcityContract.idempotence: Freeze/commit actual odds and result once by invocation. Resume/replay does not draw again.

universalFollowerContract.countMeaning: Followers/devotees are separate from army, command, victims and owned races. No army-control grant.

fixedOdds.source: User clarified nine-value ratio; earlier incomplete seven-value ratio is not active.

universalFollowerContract.rewardSelection: Only the exact committed count row for the declared caller applies. Working interpretation: rewards do not accumulate earlier count thresholds.

Other/mismatched callers are configuration errors; never fake a source race component.
universalFollowerContract.execution: Commit count, append scoped follower record and selected reward ledger atomically before one reaction; resume next child or saved caller.
universalFollowerContract.idempotence: runId/sourceComponentId/sourceFollowerInvocationId/rewardProfileId/effectOrdinal; replay/media retry repeats no record, bonus or spin.
universalFollowerContract.numericStats: Register numeric-point effects once; wait for each immutable base stat or recompute existing base plus ledger. Respect bounds/mappings; no tier increments or respins.
universalFollowerContract.mastery: Only demon-lord selected100/1000/10000/100000 gives one shared-rank modifier from actual Raja or authorized full-Raja Vessel follower source. God profile never gives follower mastery. Preserve bound Authority max; no extra draw.
universalFollowerContract.provenance: Separate follower records by source component; one God/Raja source never overwrites another count.
universalFollowerContract.history: No race/count exclusion inferred here; global race history still filters separately authorized identity draws.

authorizedAdditionalCallers.guard: Actual committed Vessel patron god, compatibility90 or100, and this recipe's actual follower child.
authorizedAdditionalCallers.projection: Use the existing matching byFollowerCount row and modifier amounts; bind all records/effects to actual Vessel/compatibility/follower source, never fabricate a God/Raja owned-race component. Follower display/context belongs to the selected patron.

authorizedAdditionalCallers.guard: Actual committed Vessel patron demon-lord, compatibility90 or100, and this recipe's actual follower child.
authorizedAdditionalCallers.projection: Use the existing matching byFollowerCount row and modifier amounts; bind all records/effects to actual Vessel/compatibility/follower source, never fabricate a God/Raja owned-race component. Follower display/context belongs to the selected patron.
authorizedAdditionalCallers.masteryModifierAccess: Existing raja-iblis-agung-follower-mastery at100/1000 +1 or10000/100000 +2, once on shared rank at final phase; other counts none.

hybridEventContract.status: User-confirmed two sequential race components with normal events and shared nested history.
hybridEventContract.eligibleFamilyPolicy: Use the complete canonical main race pool, including Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris, Anime and Heavenly Principle. Filter all previously selected families; Hybrid is already used when its event starts, so it cannot select itself.
hybridEventContract.componentResolution: Spin component 1, commit its family/history before dispatch, and finish every immediate event and nested race chain. Register later-stage tickets without advancing main stages. Only then spin component 2 using the accumulated history and run its events the same way.
hybridEventContract.distinctnessPolicy: Before every identity-family draw disable ALL previously committed families across both roots and every nested host/origin, not just the first root or final leaf. Filter before draw, never reroll forbidden results.
hybridEventContract.poolExhaustion: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
hybridEventContract.eventOrder: Hybrid result/reaction → component 1 result/reaction and complete immediate nested chain → component 2 result/reaction and complete immediate chain → record completion → saved caller. No fusion stability or dominance wheel.
hybridEventContract.eventScope: Only an actual explicit Hybrid family selection opens this two-root sequence; lore Half-Ghoul/Half-Demon/Demigod or reference ancestry does not dispatch it automatically.
hybridEventContract.journalPolicy: Two stable root slots 1/2, with separately linked host/origin descendants. Every invocation carries component/parent/root-slot and return continuation. History is shared globally.
hybridEventContract.effectsPolicy: Retain every explicitly approved grant, modifier, guarantee and deferred ticket from both actual chains. Apply each source once under source-once additive stacking with no numeric floor/cap. No blanket stat addition, halving, automatic power package, suppression or extra mastery spin.
hybridEventContract.anatomyPolicy: Store both root identities and nested modifiers in one body brief. Anatomical conflict/body-reference policy remains pending; do not invent stability/dominance results or discard committed race rewards.
hybridEventContract.returnTo: saved caller; initial main Race completion enters Archetype gate, while a Hybrid selected inside Mutant returns to the saved mutation event after both roots/events complete
hybridEventContract.size: One global Size: current normal-form profiles cover all completed owner identity routes. Use adjustable same-metric mixture or explicit principal-extent projection for mixed metrics; an explicit all-source frozen body range wins. Raksasa retains eight milestones. AI artwork prose is not a probability parameter or physical mass.
hybridEventContract.mastery: All owned powers share the existing single character mastery and scoped Authority exception. Weapons keep their normal per-weapon mastery/Enchant.
hybridEventContract.context: Append actual roots, nested families, grants, modifiers and upcoming steps with provenance. Future second race and final stats remain unknown until committed.
hybridEventContract.idempotence: Keys include root slot and nested component/step. Resume restores a committed result and continues its unfinished children, never applies history to reroll it or executes an event twice.
hybridEventContract.budgets: Validate configured event budgets can support required chains. Current numerical limits are proposed; on required overflow fail configuration, never truncate the two-root sequence.

raceAttachmentContract.status: User clarified Symbiote attaches to another race and Raksasa gives another race giant size; each requires one additional race spin.
raceAttachmentContract.dispatch: Every selected host/base family executes its normal approved events, including another authorized attachment/origin chain. Commit family to shared history BEFORE children.
raceAttachmentContract.identity: The wrapper component stays owned. Host/base is a linked descendant in the same Hybrid root when applicable, not a replacement result or an extra Hybrid root.
raceAttachmentContract.order: Working execution order: resolve host/base immediate events before returning to the attachment caller. Symbiote then runs its existing Takeover/power chain. Raksasa registers its existing stage effects once and returns after its base chain.
raceAttachmentContract.mastery: All early powers survive main None and use the one shared character rank; caller-scoped Authority max remains an exception. No host-specific mastery bonus inferred.
raceAttachmentContract.return: Always restore the saved nested caller. Only initial outer Race completion advances to the Archetype gate; attachments acquired inside Mutant restore its mutation event without a second gate or Archetype spin.

definitions.cap: Configured ordered Weapon Mastery scale; +1 means one rank step, not a stat point or automatic fixed Master. Explicit raw rank scale is weapon-mastery-0-9; final cap/overflow policy remains configuration.
