ownedMountContract.capability: Detailed animal traits, mounted functions/loadouts, operator/crew, fuel/ammunition, range, body-fit and control profiles remain configuration. Names do not grant all franchise forms/abilities or source-race events. Gustav Cannon is a heavy mounted platform; operation/crew must be defined, not inferred from its label.
ownedMountContract.replay: Freeze both pools, odds, version, mount recipe, exact stat allocation and strong weapon reference before drawing. Commit mount/buff/linked weapon atomically using one result-source ledger key and distinct effect keys; replay restores the same records without another spin, duplicate modifier or second mount/weapon.
ownedMountContract.stat: Apply the frozen exact per-mount allocation once through source-keyed modifiers. +1/+2 means the total across the five main stats, not +1/+2 to every stat. Main-stat bases remain immutable; derive final values from all source modifiers without numeric clamps. Band total is metadata, not an additional buff.
ownedMountContract.weapon: All sixteen strong outcomes count as one owned weapon each when actually selected, including animals and unusual mounts. Link weapon instance to the same mount instance; no second entity or weapon acquisition selector. Retain after main Weapon None and resolve its one ordinary per-instance mastery at the normal Weapon stage. Effective Master or above opens compatible Enchant under existing rules; compatibility profiles remain configuration. Weak/moderate mounts grant no weapon or weapon mastery.

gamblerStatPolicy.typeSelection: One equal four-type draw at Archetype; only Lucky Number then draws one equal target 0..9 before Backstory
gamblerStatPolicy.rawContract: Preserve every actual raw stat outcome, scale, odds and source spin immutable. Store resolvedBaseValue and its copy/Double/Nothing provenance separately; then apply independent stat modifiers. Missing numeric scale/mapping is needs_configuration, never arithmetic on lore-tier labels. Lucky Number also preserves actual mastery outcome and its frozen explicit match-number map; no matching against effective rank.
gamblerStatPolicy.zeroAndDouble: Nothing derives a base of exactly zero even if zero is absent from the normal draw wheel. Double can derive above the ordinary wheel maximum. Do not constrain derived values back to draw outcomes; final the signed, unbounded final-score policy are a separate policy still pending.
gamblerStatPolicy.ledger: Journal selected type and conditional lucky-number target once; freeze each actual pool/outcome/value/map/odds/version. Base/decision resolution remains source-once. Lucky Number records each matching actual stat/mastery source spin once, including late draws; settle one all-stat package only at finalize after all mandatory events. Replay/media retries add no spins/hits/modifiers.
gamblerStatPolicy.order: Actual Gambler -> one four-type spin/reaction -> register selected policy -> only for Lucky Number, one 0..9 selector/reaction -> Backstory -> Size/Cosmic -> selected main-stat schedule -> Weapon/mastery/Enchant -> Power/shared mastery -> Weakness -> Apex -> Title and mandatory late events -> finalize Lucky Number once -> freeze/image/final card. Main stage order unchanged.
gamblerStatPolicy.bonusTiming: All five main-stat bonuses/debuffs accumulate in source ledgers during generation and are calculated only at finalize, after all mandatory spins/reactions. Raw/copy/Double-Nothing bases resolve earlier without adding bonuses.

goliathChance.order: Actual Goliath result/reaction -> exactly one Berserker chance spin -> atomically apply only its selected package -> child result/reaction -> Backstory.
goliathChance.probability: Fixed user 1:9 weights: Berserker 10%, Not Berserker 90%. No equal-default replacement or unapproved odds modifiers.
goliathChance.strength: Berserker +4 total or Not Berserker +2 total, never +2 plus +4. Register a source-scoped numeric flat modifier before main stats; preserve immutable raw results and independent existing modifiers.
goliathChance.weakness: Only Berserker grants Uncontrollable Rage once, independently owned and retained through the normal later Weakness spin. Not Berserker grants no Goliath weakness and does not remove any previously owned weakness. No invented numeric debuff, severity/activation draw or penalty.
goliathChance.ledger: Freeze wheel/rule version, pool, weights, outcome and selected package. Stable key runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceChanceSpinId/eventProfileId; commit selected Strength and optional weakness atomically once. Replay/media retries add no spin, stat points, weakness or hook.
goliathChance.scope: Berserker is a Goliath outcome flag, not another Archetype spin/dispatch. No Race/Size/body transformation, weapon, power, mastery or second chance spin. Fixed Strength/weakness grants are not stat spins and produce no Lucky Number hit.

pirateRankShip.order: Actual Pirate result/reaction -> one equal rank spin -> selected 0..2-point stat recipe/reaction -> one equal cosmetic ship spin -> presentation context/reaction -> Backstory.
pirateRankShip.rankReward: Each rank grants exactly its frozen recipe total 0..2 numeric points, not that amount on every stat. Apply per-stat flat modifiers once after immutable raw bases; Crew zero/no reroll. Fixed reward is not a Lucky Number stat spin.
pirateRankShip.ship: Store only the actual selected ship identity/alias/history source as presentation.pirateShip. Ship affects visual design/narration only: no stats, power, weapon, vehicle, mastery, Enchant, crew/army, Size, command/control, hidden event or later odds modifier. Rank bonus remains unchanged.
pirateRankShip.identity: Ships are real historically attested associations, with notes for privateering/history uncertainties. Alias names for one ship share one outcome; genuinely different ships sharing a name retain separate IDs. Historical captain is reference context, not owner Race/hero/mentor/event or an ally grant.
pirateRankShip.ledger: Freeze both wheel pools/odds, rule version, selected rank recipe and cosmetic ship identity/aliases/source refs. Rank package is source-keyed to its actual rank spin; presentation record to its actual ship spin. Commit each once; replay adds no spin, stat bonus, inventory entity or second presentation record.
pirateRankShip.weaponClassification: confirmed cosmetic-only; no ship Weapon/Mastery/Enchant or gameplay vehicle

weaponAcquisitionPolicy.default: Existing main/bonus/early inventory rules remain when no exclusive lock is active.

gladiator.activation: Atomic commit of actual Gladiator weapon result and replacement package
blockedSources: queued extra Weapon acquisitions from earlier Race events
Backstory, Apex, Title and all other later weapon grants
weapon granted as a side effect of another event or enchantment
allowedOperations: normal mastery for the selected active weapon
compatible enchantment or upgrade of that same weapon
gladiator.blockedAcquisitionHandling: Skip a weapon-only acquisition spin before sampling, record skipped-by-gladiator with its source/continuation. Reject additional weapon creation in mixed-effect events but retain other explicitly declared effects. No replacement draw, conversion to power/stats or compensation.
gladiator.discardHistory: Keep previous grant/result/mastery/enchant provenance in immutable journals and inactive inventory records; remove these weapons and their instance-bound effects from active loadout/final image. Do not erase independent Race stats, powers, armor or companions.
gladiator.replay: No previous weapon is revived/regranted by replay; no second Gladiator grant. Lock persists through all later stages.

weaponAcquisitionPolicy.precedence: Active Gladiator lock overrides normal main/bonus acquisition and guaranteed weapon grants; never overrides normal mastery/compatible Enchant on its allowed instance. No fabricated None or substitute bonus.

mageDeferredPower.order: Actual Mage/reaction -> one fixed 1:9 Master Sihir chance spin -> atomically register selected deferred plan/main guarantee/one or two bonus tickets/conditional x3 bias -> child reaction -> Backstory. No early Power draw.
mageDeferredPower.counts: Ordinary Mage: one normal main + one extra = two Mage-managed spins. Master Sihir: one normal main + two extras = three. This is not a cap on all owned powers or on independent Race/Backstory bonus acquisitions; retain other source grants/tickets.
mageDeferredPower.powerStage: Bind plan to the one main Power acquisition, then consume Mage extras by ordinal through the existing bonus queue before shared mastery. Freeze fresh eligible odds at each actual spin; resolve declared acquisition details/reaction, grant and consume exactly once.
mageDeferredPower.guarantee: Every Mage-managed acquisition requires a power. Disable all no-power outcomes before drawing, normalize the remaining eligible positive weights. Other sources keep their own normal None/guarantee rules.
mageDeferredPower.tier: Only Master Sihir x3 on Tier 3-5, x1 on Tier 1-2 for its three managed draws, after hard guards. Use exact existing intrinsic 1-5 metadata; no new tier definitions or selection wheel. Unknown metadata is configuration error.
mageDeferredPower.repetition: Use the approved global Power repetition/grant policy and frozen source-scoped provenance. Two/three spins do not imply two/three distinct canonical definitions; no unique-power exclusion or duplicate reroll is added by Mage.
mageDeferredPower.mastery: Master Sihir is an outcome flag, not an automatic Power Mastery rank or a second Archetype. After all authorized acquisitions, one normal shared Power Mastery covers all powers as before. No mastery bonus, maximum, per-power spin or power Enchant.
mageDeferredPower.ledger: Freeze chance version/pool/weights/outcome and selected plan. Atomic source key runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceChanceSpinId/eventProfileId registers main binding and bonus ordinals once. Each actual later acquisition has its own frozen pool/tier references/weights/result/grant and consumes its own ticket atomically. Resume/media retry restores existing results; no extra draw, grant, ticket or repeated x3.
mageDeferredPower.reaction: At Archetype stack actual chance result, promised later spin count, guaranteed grant and any tier bias; selected powers remain unknown. Later react only to actual Power acquisitions and the one shared mastery. No caption-derived funny tag.
mageDeferredPower.scope: Mage affects deferred normal Power acquisition count/eligibility/conditional weights only. Earlier Race grants and independent bonus tickets remain; no stat/weapon/Size event or new universal power definitions.
mageDeferredPower.return: After chance result/reaction return Backstory. At later Power, finish all required acquisitions/shared mastery then Weakness; nested acquisitions restore exact saved caller.

royalChessPiece.order: Actual Royal/reaction -> one equal piece spin -> apply only selected effect or arm Pawn condition/reaction -> Bishop only one actual canonical Angelic spin/grant/reaction -> Backstory.
royalChessPiece.probability: Six equal piece base weights 1, each 1/6; Bishop uses canonical twenty Angelic entries/weights 1, each 1/20. No chess-rank rarity, promotion chance or special success wheel.
royalChessPiece.king: Grant one fixed named Authority (absolute command/will domination), ordinary power mode at explicit Tier 5. No Concept selector, God race/follower/Divine package, God Authority maximum or automatic mastery bonus. Persist after main None for one shared mastery.
royalChessPiece.fixedStats: Queen +1 each five numeric main stats; Knight +2 Speed only; Rook +2 Durability only. Source-keyed fixed modifiers, not actual stat rolls or mastery bonus. Register all five-stat modifiers now; calculate their numeric contribution only at finalize. Pawn uses raw values and may evolve earlier without applying its stat bonus yet.
royalChessPiece.bishop: Reuse power-angelic once, twenty canonical definitions/tiers/equal base weights; grant only the actual selected ordinary power. Import no Heavenly/Angel identity event, maximum or extra mastery.
royalChessPiece.pawn: Arm Beast of Possibility condition only, no early power/stat bonus. Original raw values and explicit frozen mastery mappings determine >=3 qualifying categories at >=7. First success gives one source-owned Royal High Paladin form/+2 each five main stats; no new Paladin/Archetype/race dispatch or repeated promotion.
royalChessPiece.mastery: King/Bishop owned powers retain one ordinary shared Power Mastery after all acquisitions; no Power Enchant/mastery-specific child wheel. Pawn passively observes that same raw draw and can grant its one stat/form milestone without another mastery/evolution spin.
royalChessPiece.ledger: Freeze piece pool/weights/version/result/effects and conditional Angelic invocation; commit selected fixed package or armed condition once. Pawn trigger freezes qualifying raw proof and commits form/five modifiers atomically under one evolution source key. Replay reuses snapshots, never duplicates grants, Divine draw or evolution.
royalChessPiece.reaction: Stack actual piece and declared effects; Pawn starts armed, not evolved. At successful trigger append Royal High Paladin, raw category proof and +2 per main stat in the result/milestone reaction. Future powers/masteries/stats remain unknown; no caption-derived funny tag.
royalChessPiece.return: Piece and optional Bishop child return to Backstory. Passive evolution restores exact current stat/mastery/event caller; final audit completes before image. Preserve normal Weapon/Power/Weakness/Apex/Title sequence and unrelated sources.

passiveRawStatConditions.triggerBasis: Actual raw main-stat/active Weapon Mastery/shared Power Mastery records only; explicit mapping, no projected bonuses
passiveRawStatConditions.timing: Evaluate after committed source result and before its reaction snapshot; promote immediately on the first satisfied >=3 criterion, without another spin.

evolution.label: Royal High Paladin
evolution.operation: set source-owned Royal Pawn evolved form; preserve original Royal/Pawn result and history

passiveRawStatConditions.retryCategoryPolicy: If an explicitly authorized combined Resilient profile exists, retained actual raw result qualifies; attempts remain one category. Otherwise existing actual primary result; do not create a second Archetype.

apostlePatronPower.order: Actual Apostle/reaction -> one equal patron spin -> register +1 all-owned mastery modifier/reaction -> one selected canonical Divine or Demonic spin/grant/reaction -> Backstory. Exactly two actual child spins, only one thematic branch.
apostlePatronPower.probability: God 1/2, Devil 1/2 by equal default. Reuse power-divine twenty or power-demonic twenty canonical outcomes/base weights unchanged. Base per-entry 1/20 or 1/20 before separately approved applicable modifiers; branch count does not alter 50/50 patron odds.
apostlePatronPower.grant: Grant exactly the actual selected canonical ordinary power once, sourced to the thematic child result. Freeze exact definition/grant mode/tier metadata under existing powerTierContract. No new power definition or tier boost.
apostlePatronPower.mastery: Both patrons give exactly one +1 source modifier affecting every owned ordinary power through the single common rank, including earlier/normal/bonus/future grants. Preserve actual raw mastery, the signed, unbounded score policy and source-bound God Authority maximum. Do not multiply +1 by power count or patron/thematic invocation count.
apostlePatronPower.inventory: Selected early power survives main Power None. Keep normal main/bonus acquisitions and one shared mastery inventory gate. No weapon/stat bonus, extra normal acquisition ticket, power Enchant or mastery-triggered wheel.
apostlePatronPower.identity: Patron is a spiritual-affiliation reference, not a new God/Devil race. God invokes canonical Divine; Devil invokes canonical Demonic, superseding the old Cursed branch. No Heavenly/Abyssal, followers, Concept, God scarcity/max or Utusan race dispatch.
apostlePatronPower.ledger: Freeze patron and canonical thematic pool/weights/version, modifier definition/source and actual selected power reference/tier. Commit patron/modifier once; thematic child grant once under its own source key. Restore exact saved continuations; replay/media retry gives no duplicate modifier/power/spin or second branch.
apostlePatronPower.reaction: Append actual patron and pending themed route/+1 all-power modifier, then actual selected power facts/tier. Future mastery/Backstory/stats remain unknown. No caption-derived funny-result tag.
apostlePatronPower.return: After the selected thematic child and reaction restore Backstory; retain other source grants, raw-stat conditions and the remaining main flow.

mutantRaceMutation.order: Actual Mutant result/reaction -> one canonical mutation-family draw from unused families -> commit owned root and global history before dispatch/reaction -> complete selected immediate/nested Race events -> restore Mutant continuation -> Backstory.
mutantRaceMutation.addition: The earlier Race components and their original journals/grants remain owned. Link one new root to the actual Mutant source; do not replace the base race or activate the main Hybrid event just because two races are now owned.
mutantRaceMutation.noRepeat: Use canonical family IDs, not display aliases or subtype IDs. Elf already used excludes the entire Elf family, not just the earlier Elf subtype. All preceding outer/nested families and newly committed mutation descendants share one usedRaceFamilyIds set. Vampire prey, Slayer victims, mentors and companions remain separate references.
mutantRaceMutation.raceEvents: Run normal approved new-race mechanics with actual source provenance. If the result is Hybrid, run its two roots in order; Symbiote host, Raksasa base and Skeleton/Zombie origin use their ordinary bounded routes. Finish each child chain before returning. Selecting these families schedules no second Mutant/root invocation.
mutantRaceMutation.reward: Mutant has no independent stat/power/weapon/mastery package. Gains come only from the actually acquired race and its approved events, source-once. Existing modifiers/inventory remain; source-scoped God maximum stays on its own Authority instance.
mutantRaceMutation.stageBoundary: Archetype eligibility/result was already committed against the completed pre-mutation Race tree. Reuse that frozen decision; do not re-enter the gate, redraw Archetype, undo Mutant or retroactively skip it when mutation acquires a strong/always-skip race. Raksasa acquired during mutation still binds giant Size, but cannot erase a previously selected Archetype. New identity children return to the saved event, not the top-level Race->Archetype transition.
mutantRaceMutation.deferredStages: Keep the original global Backstory->Size->five stats->Weapon/Power/mastery sequence. Mutation race events register approved later-stage effects/tickets without advancing stages. One global Size uses the completed current composition, including giant binding when applicable; no early/extra Size draw. Retain normal None ownership, per-weapon mastery/compatible Enchant and one common Power Mastery.
mutantRaceMutation.identityAndBody: Keep a frozen pre-Archetype eligibility tree/decision separately from current acquired-race composition. Mutation roots and their descendants are owned identity records, not extra children patched into an ordinary Human/Elf gate-input node. Body/fusion/Size and equipment-fit profiles must explicitly cover the current components; missing profiles require configuration, never Human fallback or inferred immunity/form/bonus.
mutantRaceMutation.ledger: Freeze rule version, canonical race catalog/weights, exclusion snapshot, selected family, owned root ID, source links and exact saved continuations. Atomically commit selection/history before child dispatch. Each inherited race effect uses its own source ledger; replay/media retry schedules no new root, repeat child event, grant or modifier.
mutantRaceMutation.bounded: Each actual identity-family commit increases the one used set; the twenty-two-family catalog bounds all original and mutation chains together. Exhaustion blocks the required child explicitly; never reopen a used family or erase a committed result.
mutantRaceMutation.reaction: At Mutant reveal, only extra-race intent is known. After mutation result append the actual added race, then actual subtypes/grants as each result commits. Future Backstory/Size/stats/mastery remain unknown; no caption-derived funny-result tag.
mutantRaceMutation.return: After every mandatory immediate mutation child returns and reacts, complete Mutant once and restore Backstory. Keep deferred tickets for their normal stages.

resilientSecondChance.order: Actual Resilient/reaction -> register deferred policy -> Backstory. At each eligible future slot: freeze pool -> first actual draw/commit/reaction -> if raw<=5 schedule and complete exactly one second actual draw/commit/reaction -> keep best raw source in separate resolution -> resume saved stage. All bonuses are accumulated for later calculation.
resilientSecondChance.selection: Keep both immutable actual source outcomes and a separate selected-base resolution. Record first/second source IDs and mapped values; never overwrite the first spin. No fixed +stat reward from Resilient itself.
resilientSecondChance.bounded: A retry is tagged attempt 2/parent resolution and cannot trigger another Resilient retry even at 0..5. At most two actual draws per slot. Deduplicate source registration and retry invocation; multiple duplicate policy references cannot stack retries.
resilientSecondChance.constraints: Both draws honor the same frozen approved hard guards, odds and scale. Kinnara minimum Master=5 applies before both draws; raw 5 still triggers retry, 6..9 do not. Lich constrained raw Durability=9 does not trigger. Missing pool/binding/compatible composite policy is needs_configuration, never bypass guards.
resilientSecondChance.mastery: Choose the retained raw mastery result before effective-rank projection or Enchant checks. One shared Power Mastery resolution has one default draw or, only for active Resilient with first raw<=5, two actual draws. Keep one shared selected base for every current/future power; no mastery per power, Power Enchant or acquisition follow-up.
resilientSecondChance.latePower: If empty inventory skips mastery, no retry exists. The first later owned power uses the first shared resolution with this policy if armed; subsequent grants reuse the settled shared result without reopening either draw.
resilientSecondChance.hooks: Each actual first/retry spin has its own committed-spin hooks and reaction. If an explicitly configured combined policy includes Lucky Number, every actual matching draw counts once, including a lower discarded retry. Reuse/best-selection/final projection creates no extra hit. No caption-derived funny tag.
resilientSecondChance.pawn: If explicitly combined with Pawn, qualifying category proof uses the retained actual raw numeric result before bonuses; max keeps any qualifying >=7 result. Keep one category per main stat, one active Weapon Mastery category and one common Power Mastery category. Do not count two attempts as two categories or grant a second evolution.
resilientSecondChance.composition: New runs normally have one selected Archetype. Combined Gambler/Resilient policy schedules remain explicit configuration; these passive observer boundaries do not authorize a second Archetype or automatic stacking.
resilientSecondChance.ledger: Freeze source policy version, scale map, first eligible pool/odds, parent resolution ID, attempt ordinals, raw result IDs/values, consumed retry key, saved caller and retained source. Persist retry-pending status after first draw; resume completes the recorded retry rather than redrawing the first or reusing a provisional base as settled.
resilientSecondChance.reaction: Only committed result facts are available. After first<=5 announce one second chance; after retry show both results and retained higher raw result. Future bonuses/final scores remain unknown.
resilientSecondChance.return: After the slot settles restore its exact next-stat/mastery/event caller; Archetype itself returns to Backstory. Do not advance to Enchant/effective projection or finalization while a required retry remains pending.
resilientSecondChance.migration: Only new authorized policy invocations use this rule. Preserve pre-Resilient journals and original scale/bonus timing; replay/render retries add no draw or reward.
resilientSecondChance.bonusTiming: At final bonus phase only, project each active weapon from its retained raw base plus distinct matching instance modifiers without numeric clamps. Project the one common Power Mastery from its retained raw base plus distinct all-owned sources, never multiplied by owned power count. Preserve source-bound God Authority maximum, which is a fixed instance override, not a numeric bonus. Evaluate only in final bonus phase after effective Weapon Mastery calculation. Effective score >=5 (Master), enchantable active weapon and an unused compatible configured slot are all required. Earlier stages retain pending gate status even if raw already >=5 or raw+known bonuses would reach5; do not spin early or permanently skip from raw alone.

statBonusTiming.registration: Source-owned numeric bonus/debuff ledger entries are recorded when earned; no addition during raw draws, retries or intermediate reveals.
statBonusTiming.calculation: After every mandatory Enchant/late event/raw draw/retry/passive Pawn evaluation finishes, process all Lucky Number eligible actual sources, settle its one modifier package, then calculate five main-stat final scores from resolved bases and distinct active bonus/debuff ledgers. Include bonuses earned by actual final-phase Enchant results, such as an already-active Shrek funny-result hook. Fixed projection/recalculation is not an actual spin/hook.
statBonusTiming.rawComparison: Resilient/Pawn/Lucky Number use frozen raw numeric bindings, never provisional or final bonus-adjusted values.
statBonusTiming.masteryCalculation: Final phase only: retained raw per-weapon/shared-power base + distinct matching modifiers, then the signed, unbounded score policy. No earlier bonus projection.

enchant.valueBasis: effective retained raw Weapon Mastery + distinct matching bonuses without numeric clamps
enchant.belowMasterAtRaw: defer, not a final eligibility skip

finalBonusPhase.registration: Record each authorized modifier when earned in its immutable source-keyed ledger; do not add it to any raw/stat/mastery result during the earlier main stages.
finalBonusPhase.raw: Complete scheduled actual stat/mastery draws and any required Resilient retry at their normal stages. Preserve all immutable results plus retained/copy/Double-Nothing base resolution. Resilient/Lucky Number/Pawn continue reading raw mapped values, never bonuses.
finalBonusPhase.mastery: At final bonus phase only, project each active weapon from its retained raw base plus distinct matching instance modifiers without numeric clamps. Project the one common Power Mastery from its retained raw base plus distinct all-owned sources, never multiplied by owned power count. Preserve source-bound God Authority maximum, which is a fixed instance override, not a numeric bonus.
finalBonusPhase.enchant: Evaluate only in final bonus phase after effective Weapon Mastery calculation. Effective score >=5 (Master), enchantable active weapon and an unused compatible configured slot are all required. Earlier stages retain pending gate status even if raw already >=5 or raw+known bonuses would reach5; do not spin early or permanently skip from raw alone.
finalBonusPhase.boundary: Only Weapon Mastery bonuses can change this threshold. Strength/other-main-stat bonuses, Power Mastery bonus and Power Tier metadata do not raise Weapon Mastery. Power Mastery never generates Enchant.
finalBonusPhase.deferred: At Weapon or a later acquisition caller, settle raw mastery then register a stable pending final Enchant gate per active weapon. Return to saved caller without an Enchant child. Empty/no weapon has no phantom pending gate; discarded weapons remain inactive.
finalBonusPhase.late: Resolve actual Enchant and its approved child events using the normal source ledgers, saved return, raw mastery policies, shared-power reuse and acquisition locks. If these create authorized inventory/modifier changes, refresh effective mastery from the same immutable base and current distinct ledger and examine only unused slots. Newly granted weapons resolve normal raw mastery; first late power may resolve the one shared base if previously empty. Never restart earlier main stages.
finalBonusPhase.drain: Process to quiescence under the existing declared event activation/depth limits. A changed ledger may be reprojected from base; it must never add the whole bonus again to a previous effective value. Each Enchant slot has one consumed activation key. Missing required catalog/compatible declared profile/bounds or exceeded event limit remains explicit needs_configuration; never fake success/freeze with pending events.
finalBonusPhase.finalStats: After every mandatory Enchant/late event/raw draw/retry/passive Pawn evaluation finishes, process all Lucky Number eligible actual sources, settle its one modifier package, then calculate five main-stat final scores from resolved bases and distinct active bonus/debuff ledgers. Include bonuses earned by actual final-phase Enchant results, such as an already-active Shrek funny-result hook. Fixed projection/recalculation is not an actual spin/hook.
finalBonusPhase.freeze: Final image/stat card wait until pending events/retries/Enchant gates are resolved or explicitly skipped by final eligibility, modifiers are calculated and final audit succeeds. Do not present a provisional projection as a frozen final score.
finalBonusPhase.replay: Freeze global policy version, original raw references, modifier-source fingerprint, active inventory snapshot, cap profile, effective rank used for each gate, pending/consumed slot keys, actual child invocations and saved final-phase cursor. Resume uses existing first/retry/Enchant results; no extra spins, grants or duplicate effects.
finalBonusPhase.migration: Pre-revision committed journals preserve their frozen early-Enchant/timing policy. No automatic relabeling, new eligibility check, reward migration or Enchant spin on an old finalized character.

steps.operation: Complete all prior mandatory Title/late events, raw stat/mastery slots and Resilient retries; keep numeric bonuses pending.
Project active per-weapon and one common power effective rank from retained raw bases and distinct sources without numeric clamps; preserve God instance override.
For each active compatible weapon, effective>=5 and unused slot -> actual Enchant spin/events; otherwise record final skip reason. All child results/reactions complete.

Complete authorized late acquisitions/raw masteries/retries and source hooks. If inventory/modifier fingerprint changed, return to calculate-effective-masteries and check only unused slots, respecting event limits.
Once no mandatory child/gate remains, audit Pawn and Lucky Number, settle Lucky modifier once, sum all five main-stat bonus/debuff ledgers against resolved bases without numeric clamps.
Audit consistent final masteries/Enchant slots/stats/provenance, then freeze and generate image/final card.

equalizerFutureOdds.order: Actual Equalizer result/reaction -> register future uniform-odds policy -> Backstory. Every subsequent actual mechanics wheel selects its valid pool, filters explicit guards, freezes uniform actual probabilities and draws the usual number of times.
equalizerFutureOdds.defaultDifference: Normal equal-default only fills unspecified base weights before explicit distributions/lore modifiers. Equalizer is a character-owned override that forces final eligible probabilities uniform even when the ordinary profile is biased or fixed. Other characters retain their configured distributions.
equalizerFutureOdds.noCatalogMutation: Replace the current invocation distribution only. Do not rewrite canonical ratios/normal Size templates/modifier definitions or a different character catalog. Record the suppressed ordinary profile references when available; an unconfigured lore-weight profile is not invented or calculated as a required counterfactual.
equalizerFutureOdds.constraints: Probability equality does not remove structural eligibility. Apply hard minimum/maximum/guaranteed-grant/no-repeat/compatibility filters first, then equalize the remaining choices. Full0..9=10% each; constrained5..9=20% each; max-only9=100%. A zero probability caused only by ordinary lore/rarity weighting can become positive under Equalizer if still independently eligible; an explicit forbidden/disabled outcome remains excluded.
equalizerFutureOdds.hierarchy: Uniform per actual wheel, not per all leaf paths or Tier1..5 groups. Do not flatten the event tree, invent a has-power/tier selector or balance unequal group counts. An actual pool None plus three allowed powers has four25% outcomes; a guaranteed-power wheel still excludes None before equalization.
equalizerFutureOdds.fixedOverride: Equalizer is a named user-authorized distribution override, not an ordinary multiplicative modifier. Fixed-wheel allowModifiers:false and ordinary God80/20/Size shape protection do not block this policy on subsequent authorized invocations. No final ordinary group-mass/ratio postprocessor may reintroduce a bias after uniformization.
equalizerFutureOdds.temporal: Do not apply to requester selection, original Race/events, the Archetype draw that selected Equalizer, or earlier frozen/committed invocations. Freeze each future wheel just in time with its active policy; source activation is part of the invocation proof. No retroactive reweighting/resampling on resume.
equalizerFutureOdds.allLater: Includes event descendants, retries, authorized late acquisition/mastery slots and final-phase Enchant. Missing Weakness/Apex/Title catalogs remain configuration; equal odds do not invent their options. Fixed grants, image/meme/narration randomness and non-wheel calculations are not extra mechanics draws.
equalizerFutureOdds.bonuses: Equalizer changes probabilities only. Retain all original grants/bonus sources and end-only bonus timing. Mastery remains per-active-weapon/one common power base, not one draw per power. God max is fixed instance override; Enchant still requires final effective Weapon Mastery>=5 and compatible unused slot.
equalizerFutureOdds.gate: Reuse the existing accepted Race->Archetype eligibility gate and chosen role. This rule does not grant Archetype to God/Raksasa/other skipped races or authorize multiple roles. Strong race examples describe hypothetical stat bias, not new eligibility.
equalizerFutureOdds.composition: A newly configured composite odds policy must explicitly declare compatible wheel variants/constraints. Once an otherwise-authorized wheel runs after active Equalizer, this uniform distribution has precedence over its weight biases. No additional Archetype/Gambler mode is inferred.
equalizerFutureOdds.ledger: Freeze rule version, active Equalizer source invocation/spin ID, activation journal index, canonical wheel/options, eligible/disabled IDs and constraint proofs, uniform weights/probabilities and suppressed profile refs before drawing. Deduplicate activation and each actual source invocation; replay/media retries reuse frozen distributions/results.

confirmedEarlyNumericBonus.timing: Record the modifier at the race result. Add once to the later rolled base numeric Strength; do not modify or reroll the base result.
confirmedEarlyNumericBonus.scaleRequirement: Strength needs a numeric value scale or an explicitly declared tier-to-numeric mapping. +1 is not one ordinal tier.

confirmedArmorBonuses.timing: Append effects as armor is awarded; add once after each target base stat roll. Do not change or reroll the recorded base.
confirmedArmorBonuses.scaleRequirement: Durability, Fight, and Speed require numeric values or explicit tier-to-numeric mappings for these flat +1 bonuses.

confirmedShrekGrowth.trigger: Each later actual committed catalog-tagged funny-result spin after Shrek Power acquisition
confirmedShrekGrowth.timing: Append one modifier per stat per unique qualifying invocation before its reaction. Add to any rolled base, or retain the effect until that base is rolled.
confirmedShrekGrowth.idempotence: Repeated evaluation and media retries add zero extra points; the bonus effect is not a spin.
confirmedShrekGrowth.mastery: Passive reward starts on acquisition; normal Power Mastery remains.
confirmedShrekGrowth.scaleRequirement: All five stats require numeric values or declared numeric mappings. preserve signed unbounded final values without rerolling the base.

trollConditionPenalty.mappingScope: Authored fantasy-game rules, not medical measurements
trollConditionPenalty.timing: Record one condition and linked modifier once at the result; apply to its later base stat. Keep the normal Weakness stage.

statsContract.sizeSeparation: Size has no flat stat bonus; declared stat-odds/0.4.0 bounded physical likelihoods are implemented. Equipment/weakness compatibility is independent.
statsContract.powerMasterySeparation: One shared raw0..9 Power Mastery, separate from intrinsic Tier1..5; distinct authored conditional control/training odds. Final shared/source-instance projections use signed uncapped bonuses; no Power Enchant.

vampire.stacking: Only the selected victim-count outcome applies; each source modifier is recorded once.

lelembutNumericEffects.timing: Record early modifiers at their committed sources, apply once through the numeric ledger after base rolls, preserve signed unbounded final values.

lichMaximumDurability.status: User max-guarantee rule: Durability base9 with no spin; bonuses/debuffs remain final-only.
lichMaximumDurability.selection: Detect committed Lich guarantee before random policies; conflict with hard exclusion9 needs configuration.
lichMaximumDurability.scheduledSpin: Skip RNG/wheel/reaction; record one source-owned fixed base9.
lichMaximumDurability.base: Fixed immutable base9, no fabricated raw spin result.
lichMaximumDurability.ledger: Final Durability = raw9 + distinct Durability modifiers, without numeric cap/floor. Example9 minus1 =8. Guarantee does not override final penalties.
lichMaximumDurability.idempotence: Register once per committed source component. Multiple sources refer to the same scheduled maximum constraint and create no extra Durability spin.
lichMaximumDurability.lateActivation: Future executor must preserve existing committed history; no silent redraw/replacement.
lichMaximumDurability.context: Explain fixed base9 in existing result/stage context; no extra spin.

mythicalBeastNumericEffects.timing: Record each source modifier at committed type selection; add through the ledger after the immutable target base roll.
mythicalBeastNumericEffects.scale: Use a declared numeric stat scale or explicit tier-to-numeric mapping; +1/+2 is not an ordinal tier increase.

golemDurabilityEffects.timing: Append one source modifier on committed type selection and add after the actual immutable base Durability roll, using the signed, unbounded final-score policy.
golemDurabilityEffects.independence: These user-set +1/+2/+3 amounts do not automatically scale with Power Mastery. Other Golem types have no declared flat Durability bonus.

symbioteNumericEffects.timing: Record at committed takeover result; add once after each immutable base stat through the ledger and the signed, unbounded final-score policy.
symbioteNumericEffects.stacking: Execute only the selected takeover profile. The 100% source total is +1 each, not +2 Strength/Durability and not an extra third power spin. Independent other approved race/equipment modifiers retain their own rules.

heavenlyNumericEffects.timing: Register once from actual subtype result and apply each after the immutable base stat using the signed, unbounded final-score policy.

followerNumericEffects.stacking: Only the exact committed count row for the declared caller applies. Working interpretation: rewards do not accumulate earlier count thresholds.
followerNumericEffects.timing: Register numeric-point effects once; wait for each immutable base stat or recompute existing base plus ledger. Respect bounds/mappings; no tier increments or respins.
followerNumericEffects.idempotence: runId/sourceComponentId/sourceFollowerInvocationId/rewardProfileId/effectOrdinal; replay/media retry repeats no record, bonus or spin.

animeNumericEffects.timing: Register once at the committed MC Role result and project after its base stat. Late sources recompute final from immutable base plus distinct ledger entries.

dragonNumericEffects.timing: Commit modifiers atomically with the form result before reaction; preserve immutable base and project through the existing final-stat ledger. +2 is a total budget, never +2 each stat.
dragonNumericEffects.lateActivation: If an authorized source is acquired after a base stat exists, reproject from that same base and current distinct modifiers; no new stat spin.

gambler.order: Actual raw results -> approved raw/copy/Double-Nothing base resolution -> finalize-only main-stat bonus/debuff ledger calculation -> explicitly configured final multipliers/bounds.
gambler.allInCopy: First Strength raw value copied as all five resolved bases; later four draw slots skip. Per-stat racial/other flat bonuses retain their own keys; no Strength-bonus copying.
gambler.doubleOrNothing: Double/nothing derives 2*rawValue or 0 before modifiers; never use ordinary final multiplier ledger to double bonuses.
gambler.configuration: Raw numeric 0..9/match maps explicitly defined in content/stat-scales-design.json; Intelligence labels, typed bonus-stat and constraint composition remain configuration.
gambler.luckyNumber: Select one number 0..9 once; count distinct actual raw stat/Weapon Mastery/one shared Power Mastery draws matching the frozen target, including declared late bonus-stat draws. At finalize after all mandatory events, apply one +hitCount flat package to each main stat, once.

goliathNumericEffects.order: Apply selected flat amount once to the resolved Strength base under existing the signed, unbounded final-score policy and independent modifiers; raw source results remain immutable
goliathNumericEffects.luckyNumber: Fixed grants are not actual stat/mastery draws and do not count as Lucky Number hits

pirateNumericEffects.luckyNumber: Fixed rank modifiers do not count as actual stat/mastery spins
pirateNumericEffects.shipRole: cosmetic-only, zero gameplay effect; rank recipes unchanged

pawnEvolution.qualifiesFrom: immutable raw scores >=7 in at least three stat categories, before bonuses

royalNumericEffects.timing: Register source-owned flat modifiers on piece/evolution; calculate numeric contribution only at finalize. Raw qualification excludes every bonus.

activeNumericScale.mode: numeric gameplay points for main stats; ordered ranks for mastery
activeNumericScale.finalMainStatBounds: Signed unbounded final scores; raw0..9 unchanged. No automatic final clamp.

bonusTiming.registration: Source-owned numeric bonus/debuff ledger entries are recorded when earned; no addition during raw draws, retries or intermediate reveals.
bonusTiming.calculation: After every mandatory Enchant/late event/raw draw/retry/passive Pawn evaluation finishes, process all Lucky Number eligible actual sources, settle its one modifier package, then calculate five main-stat final scores from resolved bases and distinct active bonus/debuff ledgers. Include bonuses earned by actual final-phase Enchant results, such as an already-active Shrek funny-result hook. Fixed projection/recalculation is not an actual spin/hook.
bonusTiming.rawComparison: Resilient/Pawn/Lucky Number use frozen raw numeric bindings, never provisional or final bonus-adjusted values.
bonusTiming.masteryCalculation: Final phase only: retained raw per-weapon/shared-power base + distinct matching modifiers, then the signed, unbounded score policy. No earlier bonus projection.

enchant.valueBasis: effective retained raw Weapon Mastery + distinct matching bonuses without numeric clamps
enchant.belowMasterAtRaw: defer, not a final eligibility skip

resilient.selectedBase: Separate best-of-at-most-two raw source resolution; raw journals immutable.
resilient.bonusOrder: Retain highest raw source before any bonus. Both masteries calculate only at final phase and effective Weapon Mastery then gates Enchant; all five main-stat bonus totals settle after required Enchant/late events.

conditionalOdds.status: Implemented pure conditional planner, external inverse-CDF selection and actual raw/retry/decision resolution; no persistent/video executor.
conditionalOdds.inference: One most-specific prior per physical owner identity; composite centers80% maximum +20% component mean per axis; declared role/event/physical Size shifts produce tempered likelihood tilt of each distinct raw prior. Freeze uncapped and final play distribution separately.
conditionalOdds.capAlgorithm: Floor-reserved water filling: p(i)=5%+min(lambda*weight(i),20%); solve shared lambda in log space to total100%, preserving free-sector excess ratios above5%. Never clip then renormalize.
conditionalOdds.capScope: Each actual random tier draw, including each Resilient attempt. Does not constrain retained keep-best distribution, All In copies, final boosted numeric scores or separate50:50 Double/Nothing decision wheels.
conditionalOdds.infeasiblePool: If N*minimum>1 or N*maximum<1 after hard guards, return needs_configuration. Default normal random pool requires at least4 outcomes. Never invent options or bypass guards.
conditionalOdds.equalizer: Uniform eligible RANDOM outcomes. God shared9 and Lich Durability9 are fixed/skipped rather than wheels.
conditionalOdds.bonusSeparation: Final bonus ledger is not a probability input. Capacity/training lore parameters are separately authored, never derived by replaying direct reward recipes.
conditionalOdds.size: Use this owner committed normal-form Size only; bounded log relative to declared base extent. Strength/Durability and movement respond separately; no cognition/mastery increase from body extent. AI/avatar/spirit/nanobot manifestation and transformation sizes do not create physical mass.
conditionalOdds.powerMastery: One shared ordinary random plan when owned powers exist; actual God/qualified Vessel God fixes that shared base9 for all powers without RNG. Per-weapon ordinary plans unchanged.
conditionalOdds.freeze: Copy original sources, profile versions/vectors, model/likelihood rules, Size/ref/response, inventory, hard constraints, raw mapping and minimum/maximum bounds and bounded probabilities before each actual draw. Replay saved plans; Resilient reuses frozen pool. Stage caller supplies completed canonical owner facts and actual role source IDs.
conditionalOdds.backstory: All38 designs approved. Five explicit numeric current-stat lore rules, other approved qualitative future-pool intents pending bindings. Bonuses separate/final-only.

maximumGuarantees.scope: Actual committed maximum guarantees for stats or mastery skip the random wheel.
maximumGuarantees.God: Actual God subtype fixes the one shared Power Mastery base9 for all owned present/future powers, including Authority, Divine and ordinary grants.
maximumGuarantees.VesselGod: God patron at compatibility60/70/80/90/100 inherits the existing maximum guarantee; all owned Power Mastery base9. Lower bands and demon patron do not qualify.
maximumGuarantees.Lich: Committed Lich fixes Durability base9; no singleton100% spin in new runs.
maximumGuarantees.notGuarantees: High lore probability, intrinsic Tier5, matching power names and Kinnara minimumMaster are not maximum guarantees.
maximumGuarantees.timing: Check owned inventory/guarantee before RNG; fixed base then applicable bonuses/debuffs only at finalize. Final scores remain signed/unbounded.
maximumGuarantees.hooks: No random sample, actual attempt, spin ID, Lucky hit, Resilient retry, Double/Nothing decision or sampled Pawn category for automatic bases.
maximumGuarantees.precedence: Explicit maximum before random shaping/Equalizer/Gambler. Contradictory hard exclusions require configuration. Empty power inventory creates no phantom mastery.
maximumGuarantees.history: Existing frozen actual God/ordinary mastery and Lich singleton draws replay unchanged; no retroactive guarantee rewriting.

contextStack.status: Stacked context requested by user; field layout and resolution policies are design proposals
contextStack.purpose: Give autonomous AI a consistent accumulated view of the character for narration, captions, and meme selection.

contextStack.updatePolicy: After outcome effects and deterministic hooks commit atomically, record the factual context layer before generating the reaction. Include actual hook bonuses. Fixed reveals add context without manufacturing a spin.
contextStack.snapshotPolicy: Generate the reaction packet from the journal prefix ending at the current committed spin. A precomputed final character must not leak future outcomes into earlier reactions.
contextStack.resolutionPolicy: Keep an append-only context history and project the currently active facts. Superseded or conditional traits retain their history but are not presented as simultaneously active. Hybrid root and descendant facts remain source-scoped throughout; completion assembles actual identities for a coherent body brief without an invented stability/dominance result.
contextStack.pendingPolicy: Unchosen candidates, null or draft trait profiles, proposed effects, and untriggered events are not character facts. Missing traits stay unknown; autonomous AI cannot invent them.
contextStack.sourcePolicy: Research sources support reference identity/theme only. The game-approved catalog defines which context is supplied. External lore does not automatically grant powers, personality, equipment, or stats.
contextStack.mechanicsBoundary: Context is a read-only projection for presentation. Eligibility, odds, actual grants, and stat changes come from the mechanics journal. Narration cannot change an outcome or its effects.
reactionPacket: Current result, frozen odds, actual effects and unlocks

acceptanceScenarios: A race event changes archetype or stat odds and returns to archetype.
Multiple early results combine their applicable modifiers without affecting unrelated wheels.
Each of the five main stats rolls once and receives its own reaction.
Below-master weapon skips enchantment; master and above open one compatible slot.
Main None weapon/power results skip mastery only when the full corresponding owned collection is empty.
Power mastery never schedules an enchantment wheel.
No apex skips boost; obtained apex performs the composite boost spin.
A hidden title event grants a power, resolves its mastery, and returns to finalization.
A late mastery upgrade opens only a previously unused eligible enchantment slot.
An always-on penalty changes final stats; a conditional weakness is labeled with its condition.
Seed plus versions and invocation IDs reproduce identical mechanics even when narration or rendering is retried.
Empty pools, unbounded event recursion, or unavoidable spin-budget overflow produce explicit errors.
Wheel sector angles agree with logged probabilities; caption/art/stat card agree with final state.
Forest Elf retains Forest Control and rolls its mastery when the main Power result is None.
Atlantean Warrior retains Trishula for weapon mastery and adds +1 numeric Strength once after its base stat is rolled.
Sea Elf uses fixed 60/40 conditional odds; Fey Elf receives only the selected season power.
Each ranked universal thematic power wheel grants exactly one power with no lower-rank bundle, automatic mastery, or power enchantment.
Replayed early-grant commits do not duplicate powers, weapons, or the Strength modifier.
Dwarf count weights normalize to 5/15, 4/15, 3/15, 2/15, and 1/15 under the disclosed typo interpretation.
Dwarf count N commits exactly N unique piece spins; selected armor IDs have zero probability in every subsequent draw.
A five-piece armor event performs its final 100% spin and grants +3 numeric Durability, +1 Fight, and +1 Speed exactly once.
Each awarded armor has one linked modifier; replaying a result or media generation cannot duplicate its armor or bonus.
A selected Gnome Tech is one owned weapon with unresolved mastery, retained and mastered when the main Weapon result is None.
Goblin uses army weights totaling 46, then always spins Bos/Kacung 1:1, even for army count 0.
A Goblin with 10000 associated troops and Kacung controls 0; Bos with 0 remains valid without reroll.
Orc roles use exactly 1:2:3:3:1. General uses the documented shared army wheel and controls the rolled count.
Oni receives Katana and exactly one shared Cursed Power without activating Elf events; both owned instances get mastery at their later stages.
Orc Warrior consumes one extra Weapon ticket at the Weapon stage; prefilter None to guarantee a granted extra weapon, with independent mastery.
Shaman consumes one extra Power ticket at the Power stage; each acquired owned power remains at the later mastery gate.
Shrek acquisition gives zero immediate numeric bonus; two distinct funny-result commits add +2 to all five stats, and replay adds zero.
A normal untagged outcome receiving a funny meme gives Shrek zero bonus; hook effects and fixed reveals are not qualifying spins.
A funny Shrek weapon grants one weapon and +1 per stat once; mastery and enchantment obey the normal rules.
Troll draws exactly one of twelve game conditions and records one mapped -1 point modifier; the normal later Weakness spin still occurs.
Every character receives one Size spin after all Backstory events and before any of the five main-stat spins.
Raksasa finishes its base chain, records Archetype skip with zero spins/tickets, then Backstory; one giant Size and eligible Cosmic remain.
Replaying the committed Raksasa skip reuses its policy/journal and generates no new spin, ticket or funny-result hook.
Ordinary Size generates twelve positions including explicit bounds, rounds whole values and merges duplicate sectors; normalized eligible weights remain finite/positive and sum to one.

Ordinary Size uses the selected declared race/subrace+Archetype or all-source composite body range and metric; missing data/ties need configuration, with no Human fallback or external mount/combat footprint as body height.
Raksasa anywhere overrides ordinary body support with eight abnormal milestones/default1/8; no additional Size draw. Explicit giant likelihoods/factors can adjust odds before freeze.
Size equal to 12756000 meters does not trigger Cosmic; size 1400000000 meters does. A later explicit size beyond the threshold can also trigger its unused reward.
The size threshold grants exactly one cosmic power through power-cosmic and consumes the reward once; retries and repeated threshold checks add no power.
Dark Elf and Oni share canonical power-cursed twenty outcomes/base weights with their own caller provenance; old source snapshots keep the twelve-option pool.

Holy/Blood/Cosmic/Symbiote stay twelve each. Cursed/Divine/Demonic/Angelic are twenty each, ordered Tier 1–5 four per tier; one canonical wheel per theme. Elf aliases remain lookup references, Demonic is independent.
An early cosmic power still receives normal Power Mastery even if main Power is None; no power enchantment opens.
Reactions before Size or Cosmic results never claim their future outcomes, and Size alone does not auto-award numerical stats or survival powers.
Fairy subraces have exactly four outcomes in the user order, with weights 4:2:3:1 and probabilities 40/20/30/10 percent.
Fairy Parents grants exactly one Wish Granting power with no unrequested Wish wheel or three-wish count; Healer Fairy grants one Healing Power.
Element Pixie makes exactly one call to element-universal and gains one chosen element and one linked manipulation power; no Elemental race or Summer identity is dispatched.
Summer Fey Elf and Element Pixie/Api share one unchanged-ID Fire Manipulation definition and keep distinct caller/season context.
Fairy King consumes one extra Power ticket before owned-power mastery and applies +2 rank steps to every owned power, including early and bonus grants, as confirmed by the user.
Fairy King bonus keeps base mastery immutable, caps effective rank at maximum, and gives no numeric main-stat/weapon-mastery boost or power enchantment.
Repeated mastery evaluation/media retries cannot turn King +2 into +4. Later powers inherit the existing shared mastery and active +2 without their own base spin.
If main and Fairy King bonus draws leave owned power inventory empty, skip all mastery spins while retaining valid acquisition results.
Element has equal default base odds; Fairy size references remain explicit design gaps with no silent Human height.

User clarifies that 12 means species choices on the Siluman wheel, not twelve animals per character. Add Kelelawar and Elang to the ten accepted species; one equal animal spin per character, no count selector. Normal form is humanoid with selected-animal traits; Animal Transformation exposes the one full animal form and return form.
Replaying Siluman completion or committing another animal for the same source component does not duplicate its power or reroll mastery.
Animal Transformation survives a None main Power result and gets normal pending Power Mastery; partial/fused forms, numeric stat boosts, and power enchantment are not inferred.

Lelembut Lokal invokes only its twelve retained local types and Impor only its six retained imported types; origin/type base weights are equal. Removed Ghoul/Wraith/Poltergeist/Banshee/Dullahan/Jiangshi never enter active odds.
Every retained Lelembut type applies exactly its recorded event/grants, not all optional source-theme abilities. Every early power keeps unresolved mastery even when main Power is None.
Kuyang owns two fixed powers Flight and Organ Control. Kuntilanak shares Flight; neither call duplicates the canonical definition.
Tuyul and Siluman Babi reference one Nyolong definition. Babi Nyolong and shared Animal Transformation are independent grants; replaying either source completion duplicates neither.
Banaspati references the same Fire Manipulation definition as Summer Fey Elf and Pixie/Api, without another Element spin.
Vampire prey selection retains personal Vampire identity and dispatches no prey events under the disclosed reference interpretation; even zero victims retains both real spin reactions.

Vampire victim weights sum to 18, probabilities sum to one, and 0/1/5/10 give no stat modifier. 100 and 1000 give exactly +1 on each stat; 1000 opens exactly one canonical Cursed draw, with no additional 100-threshold reward.
Leak and qualifying Vampire use the existing power-cursed wheel with actual caller provenance and saved return, not an Elf/Oni-specific event chain.

Lich consumes exactly one deferred normal Power bonus before all owned mastery. Proposed Durability constraint keeps the actual scheduled maximum-only draw and reaction, never a post-roll base replacement.
Ghost owns Intangibility for passing through solids, not invisibility or X-ray vision. Mummy owns Sand Manipulation.
Suster Ngesot owns Ngesot plus one -1 numeric Speed modifier. Narrator jokes do not automatically tag the result funny for Shrek.
Skeleton/Zombie source spin excludes Lelembut already committed by the main race, inherits the selected family approved events, and preserves the root undead identity.
Skeleton -> Elf -> High Elf grants one canonical Holy Power through Elf events; other Elf results and future outcomes remain unknown until actually drawn.
Zombie -> Raksasa preserves undead/base grants and giant Size binding, and skips Archetype; there is still one global Size.
After Lelembut and Hybrid are committed in an origin chain, confirmed Hybrid root draws exclude both and every prior character family; the second parent also excludes the first parent.

Character race respins use all previously committed families, not only the last family. Exclude them before freezing odds; retain remaining declared weights and normalize, with no reroll of selected results.

sizeContract.phase: After Backstory and all immediate events, before Strength and the other four main stats.
sizeContract.invocations: Every character gets exactly one main Size spin. Raksasa replaces its ordinary Size variant with the eight giant milestones; it does not add a second mandatory Size spin.
sizeContract.unit: Integer display values in a profile-wide mm/cm/m/km unit; canonical meters and safe integer millimeters.
sizeContract.meaning: A declared characteristic body dimension: humanoid height, elongated body length, or spherical diameter. Exclude wingspan unless the profile explicitly selects it. Celestial labels compare that linear dimension with the reference diameter.

normal.rangeAuthority: Versioned selected race/subrace/form interval and applicable Archetype, sourced or explicitly user-authorized assumption; no universal Human or 0.5–2x fallback.
normal.autoSpacing: Authored default: exponential when max/min >= 10; otherwise linear. Threshold editable per profile.
normal.rounding: Whole display-unit values; optional integer quantum, endpoints preserved, clamp within bounds.
normal.duplicatePolicy: Merge equal rounded values and sum broad-normal sample mass. Never show duplicate sectors; narrow ranges may have fewer than 12 outcomes.
normal.weighting: Broad-normal component priors, then versioned conditional Bayesian evidence and joint interactions; display spacing is independent of posterior odds.
normal.centerDefault: Midpoint fallback only; calibrated profiles explicitly supply a source-derived mean/typical/estimated center. Not necessarily the truncated wheel mean.
normal.sigmaDefault: Half coordinate span fallback; calibrated lore intervals use half their source span. Broad-width shape is authored, never an empirical sigma claim.
normal.equalMode: Explicit equal profile or active Equalizer uses one weight per unique eligible sector.
normal.modifiers: Explicit model likelihoods/mixture influences/factors before freeze, dependency grouping; Equalizer makes displayed hard-eligible outcomes uniform.

giant.coordinate: User-named milestones across orders of magnitude; magnitude spacing does not assign odds
giant.parameterStatus: User-confirmed equal probability default; previous assistant-proposed log-Gaussian odds retired.
giant.weightFormula: Default prior w_i=1,p_i=1/8; only explicit giant-scoped likelihoods/factors modify these before freeze.
giant.spacing: Keep all eight user-specified milestones, including Planet Size and Sun Size.

sizeContract.profileResolution: Raksasa support override -> explicit all-source body profile -> one most-specific normal-form prior per completed owner identity -> same-metric mixture or declared principal-extent projection -> conditional likelihoods -> readable whole-number wheel.
sizeContract.averageAuthority: Record the selected source and version. A stated mean may be used directly; a midpoint/rounded anchor from a lore range is a labeled game estimate, not a measured population mean.
sizeContract.baselineFreeze: Save context sources, all component priors, model/version/parameters, applied/skipped rules, full posterior, display projection and final odds before one external draw; no reroll or model update on replay.
sizeContract.stats: Size has no flat stat bonus; declared stat-odds/0.4.0 bounded physical likelihoods are implemented. Equipment/weakness compatibility is independent.
sizeContract.lateChange: An explicitly approved later size change records its own effect/context and checks the same cosmic threshold without rerolling earlier Size or stat results.
sizeContract.identityScope: Only committed owner identities: exclude Slayer prey, Warlord troops, Vampire victims, Disciple mentors, companions, mounts and equipped external mechs.
sizeContract.archetypeRange: Archetype may select a declared prior range or a conditional likelihood/interaction. Evidence already encoded in a prior is skipped unless an explicit joint interaction is declared.

cosmicTrigger.trigger: A Size result or explicit later size-change effect commits
cosmicTrigger.guard: character.sizeMeters > 12756000 AND cosmic size reward has not already been consumed
cosmicTrigger.comparison: Strict > Earth equatorial diameter; equal Planet Size does not qualify.
cosmicTrigger.repeatPolicy: One size-threshold reward per character, even on repeated evaluation or later repeated crossings. Other independent authorized Cosmic calls remain possible with their own event keys.
cosmicTrigger.grant: One cosmic power instance from the universal wheel; keep other powers.
cosmicTrigger.masteryTiming: main-power-stage if early; owned-power subflow and saved caller return if late
cosmicTrigger.ordering: Commit Size and context, react, then resolve Cosmic Power and its reaction before continuing to main stats.
cosmicTrigger.notInferred: Planet/Sun body scale does not itself grant vacuum survival, immortality, mastery, or an Apex Force.

runtime.input: Completed validated owner-only raceFacts projection with committed canonical results/source/spin IDs; actual archetypeIds; stable run/character/invocation IDs.
runtime.composition: Compatible physical race profiles automatically form an adjustable mixture prior. Explicit bodySizeProfile binds all owner source IDs and fixes actual body support. Different metrics require that explicit profile.
runtime.freeze: Save context sources, all component priors, model/version/parameters, applied/skipped rules, full posterior, display projection and final odds before one external draw; no reroll or model update on replay.
runtime.ledger: Pure helper emits source keys/followup activation key; caller atomically consumes them to prevent duplicate Size/Cosmic execution.
runtime.scope: Planner/draw/result helpers only. Full engine, body generator, persistent journal and video renderer remain future work.

probabilistic.formula: P(size|context) ∝ P_prior(size)^priorStrength × product(P(context_group|size)^effectiveStrength) × explicit factors; normalize on hard-eligible support.
probabilistic.modelClass: Discrete conditional Bayesian/tempered likelihood model; strength1 is the declared ordinary Bayesian update. Lore likelihood parameters are authored, not validated probabilities of real-world observations.
probabilistic.raceComposition: One specific prior per owned body identity; mixture over the same metric or explicit per-profile principal-extent projection for mixed metrics. Explicit all-source body profile wins; no hidden Human fallback.
probabilistic.mixtureFormula: P_prior(size) = sum(normalizedRaceInfluence_j * P_j(size)); union of whole-number supports, no multiplying contradictory absolute-body densities.
probabilistic.dependencies: Subtype already encoded in selected prior is not treated as an independent observation again. One most-specific rule per dependency group; equal-specificity ties need configuration. Explicit interaction=true is a conditional joint correction, not a duplicate independent clue.
probabilistic.evidenceScope: Canonical committed owner family/results/Archetype IDs only. External troops/prey/mentors/equipment and future uncommitted spins are not context evidence.
probabilistic.display: Condition the full finite candidate distribution first, then approximate at most12 readable whole-number sectors by posterior quantiles/nearest bins. Sum assigned mass; preserve full posterior and projection mapping. Single12-point profile remains unchanged.
probabilistic.equalizer: Override final displayed hard-eligible sectors to uniform; suppress soft lore bias, preserve physical support/guards.
probabilistic.numerics: Log-space likelihood normalization avoids product underflow; reject contradictory all-zero likelihood unless Equalizer suppresses soft bias.
probabilistic.giant: Raksasa fixes abnormal support of eight milestones. Default prior1/8; only explicitly scoped giant evidence/factors can change odds. Initial lore rules are normal-only.
probabilistic.calibration: Selected lore centers and explicit user-authorized normal-form intervals for complete current identity coverage. Broad widths, mixture/conditional strengths and principal-extent projection remain authored; not empirical population probabilities.
probabilistic.freeze: Save context sources, all component priors, model/version/parameters, applied/skipped rules, full posterior, display projection and final odds before one external draw; no reroll or model update on replay.
probabilistic.legacy: probabilityModel:null deliberately selects archived-style range planning; committed0.2 plans continue resolving unchanged.

compositionMetricPolicy.authority: User permits authored Size assumptions for remaining identities and compositions. Only profiles explicitly declaring their source metric and scale1 may participate.
compositionMetricPolicy.interpretation: Mixture uncertainty about dominant normal-form principal dimension; not multiplying simultaneous body measurements or asserting a real-world height/length equivalence.

profileCoverage.scope: Every terminal owned race/subrace identity in the current canonical identity routes has a default normal-form profile or an explicit host/origin/giant/composition policy. Shared subtype profiles are deliberate; no unknown Human fallback.

universalPowerContract.scope: One canonical wheel for each theme, shared by all races, characters, archetypes, events, and other approved callers. Do not combine all themes into one mega-pool.
universalPowerContract.grant: Only the selected one power; no bundle of lower-ranked options.

universalPowerContract.odds: A canonical theme uses the same definitions and base weights for every caller. Only declared approved modifiers may alter conditional odds; no caller-specific copy.
universalPowerContract.mastery: Early grants remain owned and unresolved until main Power Mastery. None removes no earlier grant; power mastery never creates enchantment.
universalPowerContract.rank: Relative potential is not mastery, rarity, main stats, or Apex Force.
universalPowerContract.sourceAuthority: Power descriptions are authored game capacities, not franchise packages or scientific claims.
universalPowerContract.registry: Race design imports each wheel by canonical ID. Definitions and outcomes exist only here; importing references are not duplicate active wheels.
universalPowerContract.weights: Equal base weight 1: twenty-outcome themes each 5% per outcome, four outcomes per tier (20% per tier). Other twelve-outcome themes each 1/12. Only explicit approved modifiers change conditional odds; tier ordering adds no rarity.
universalPowerContract.symbioteDraws: power-symbiote grants one selected power per invocation. Symbiote 80/90% schedules one invocation, 100% schedules two sequential invocations, each with its own actual spin, grant, reaction and source ordinal. Takeover stat stacking is governed by the separate Symbiote event contract.

powerMasteryContract.gate: Finish main Power acquisition, immediate acquisition events/details and all authorized bonus acquisitions. Check the entire owned power inventory, including racial grants.

powerMasteryContract.reuse: Reuse settled shared raw base without spin; before final phase keep ordinary effective bonus projection pending, at final phase read/recompute it from immutable base/current ledger. A recorded retry-pending base is not yet settled.

Raja followers 100/1000 add +1, 10000/100000 +2 through one source modifier. High-count Raja rows and every God row give no follower mastery. powerMasteryContract.lateModifier: Register source pending without an earlier projection. At final phase recompute common effective rank from retained immutable base and distinct sources, preserving source-bound Authority base9 plus shared modifiers; no respin or cumulative addition.

powerAcquisitionContract.thematic: Eight universal thematic wheels remain separate and equal-base; helpers remove already-owned powers and grant one selected ordinary power per invocation. Early calls require actual caller/source/return, never future Size.
powerAcquisitionContract.ownership: Exact canonical definition/file/grantMode, never caption. Main drawn ordinary powers already owned excluded before every draw. Identical fixed grant mode+bounded binding merges source provenance once; Authority mode/source binding stays distinct.
powerAcquisitionContract.emptyPool: needs_configuration preserving committed state. No fallback pool, repeated reward, reroll or dropped guaranteed draw.
powerAcquisitionContract.mastery: One shared mastery after all acquisitions. Empty inventory skips. Actual God/qualified Vessel max base9 skips all mastery RNG; ordinary settled base reused for late powers. Final-only signed unbounded bonuses; no Power Enchant.
powerAcquisitionContract.runtime: Pure stage/next-pool/themed/CDF/grant/fixed-merge/shared-mastery helpers. Persistent scheduler/atomic store and attack/image/video adapters remain future.

weaknessContract.otherRaces: Equal compatible leaves until separately configured; non-Human explicit body capability adapter.

effects.scope: One main draw after Power; approved immediate Backstory extra uses same pool and saved return before Size.
effects.none: No extra weakness, never clear previous Cursed/Rage/Overload/Backstory weaknesses.
effects.duplicate: Same canonical definition merges distinct source provenance, never doubles penalties; independent actual draws may repeat.
effects.conditional: Only an explicit active combat-condition guard applies a conditional restriction. Never subtract it from always-on final stats.
effects.powerRestriction: Power constraints dormant without an owned usable power; grant no power and do not lower numeric mastery.
effects.source: Actual committed owner identity and role only; no prey/army/companion/mentor/caption/future evidence.
effects.context: Neutral condition/effect wording for health/vision; no disability or mental-health insult, body-shaming narration or real diagnosis.
effects.funny: Only explicit funnyResult on actual spin supplies existing Shrek source-once hook; fixed grants/projections are not spins.
effects.timing: Register once; numeric effects apply final-only and remain signed/unbounded. No new mastery/Enchant/Size spin.
effects.extraWheels: None of these forty recipes automatically invokes severity, activation-chance or countermeasure wheel.
effects.freeze: Freeze current eligibility, odds and recipes before external RNG; preserve old frozen draws.
effects.atomic: Caller persists selected receipt and consumed request together, comparing current ownership fingerprint. Pure helper does not persist.

weaknessContract.status: Design and scoped pure helpers ready; production adapters pending.
